creators.name: Peter H. Kahn Jr.
creators.role: Professor of Psychology and of Environmental and Forest Sciences, University of Washington; director of the Human Interaction with Nature and Technological Systems (HINTS) Lab
creators.bio: Psychologist who studies how people relate to nature and to 'technological nature' such as robot pets, nature webcams and plasma-screen windows.
creators.why: He coined 'technological nature' and warned of a shifting baseline in which mediated nature slowly replaces the real thing.
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学心理学及环境与森林科学教授，Human Interaction with Nature and Technological Systems (HINTS) 实验室主任
creators.bio_zh: 心理学家，研究人如何与自然、以及与“技术化的自然”（机器宠物、自然直播、等离子屏窗景）建立关系。
creators.why_zh: 他提出了“技术化的自然”这一概念，并警示“基线漂移”：被媒介化的自然会逐渐取代真实的自然。

creators.name: Masashi Soga
creators.role: Associate Professor, Graduate School of Agricultural and Life Sciences, University of Tokyo
creators.bio: Conservation ecologist who studies how and why people's direct contact with nature is declining.
creators.why: With Kevin Gaston he framed the 'extinction of experience' that makes human–nature interaction a design problem.
creators.role_zh: 东京大学农学生命科学研究科副教授
creators.bio_zh: 保护生态学家，研究人与自然的直接接触为何、以及如何在减少。
creators.why_zh: 他与 Kevin Gaston 提出“经验的灭绝”，让人与自然的交互成为一个需要设计介入的问题。

creators.name: Roger S. Ulrich
creators.role: Professor of Architecture and Landscape Architecture, Texas A&M University (emeritus)
creators.bio: Environmental psychologist whose hospital studies founded evidence-based healing design.
creators.why: His 1984 window study is the reference point for every screen, window and VR scene that claims to deliver nature's benefits.
creators.role_zh: 德州农工大学建筑与景观建筑系教授（荣休）
creators.bio_zh: 环境心理学家，他的医院研究奠定了循证疗愈设计的基础。
creators.why_zh: 他 1984 年的窗景研究，是所有声称能带来自然益处的屏幕、窗户和 VR 场景的参照点。

creators.name: Rachel & Stephen Kaplan
creators.role: Environmental psychologists, University of Michigan
creators.bio: Husband-and-wife research team who studied why natural settings restore people's attention.
creators.why: Their Attention Restoration Theory gives designers a model of what a restorative nature experience needs: soft fascination, being away, extent and compatibility.
creators.role_zh: 密歇根大学环境心理学家
creators.bio_zh: 一对夫妻研究者，研究自然环境为何能恢复人的注意力。
creators.why_zh: 他们的注意力恢复理论给设计者一个模型：恢复性的自然体验需要柔和的吸引、远离感、延展性与契合度。

creators.name: Edward O. Wilson
creators.role: Biologist, Harvard University (1929–2021)
creators.bio: Biologist known for sociobiology, island biogeography and his work on ants and biodiversity.
creators.why: He named 'biophilia', the idea that humans have an innate need to affiliate with other living things.
creators.role_zh: 哈佛大学生物学家（1929–2021）
creators.bio_zh: 生物学家，以社会生物学、岛屿生物地理学以及蚂蚁与生物多样性研究闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他提出“亲生命性”（biophilia）：人天生需要与其他生命发生联结。

creators.name: Stephen R. Kellert
creators.role: Professor of Social Ecology, Yale School of the Environment (1943–2016)
creators.bio: Social ecologist who turned the biophilia hypothesis into principles for architecture and design.
creators.why: His biophilic design patterns are the most used checklist for bringing nature into built environments.
creators.role_zh: 耶鲁大学环境学院社会生态学教授（1943–2016）
creators.bio_zh: 社会生态学家，把亲生命性假说转化为建筑与设计原则。
creators.why_zh: 他的亲生命设计模式是把自然引入建成环境最常用的一套清单。

creators.name: Richard Louv
creators.role: Journalist and author; co-founder of the Children & Nature Network
creators.bio: Writer on children, nature and technology.
creators.why: He coined 'nature-deficit disorder' and put the screen-versus-outdoors question on the public agenda.
creators.role_zh: 记者、作家，Children & Nature Network 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 关注儿童、自然与技术的作家。
creators.why_zh: 他提出“自然缺失症”，把“屏幕还是户外”变成公共议题。

creators.name: F. Stephan Mayer
creators.role: Professor of Psychology, Oberlin College
creators.bio: Social psychologist who studies how connected people feel to the natural world.
creators.why: His Connectedness to Nature Scale is the standard outcome measure in HCI studies of nature technology.
creators.role_zh: 欧柏林学院心理学教授
creators.bio_zh: 社会心理学家，研究人对自然世界的联结感。
creators.why_zh: 他的“自然联结量表”是 HCI 中评估自然类技术时最常用的指标。

creators.name: Miles Richardson
creators.role: Professor of Human Factors and Nature Connectedness, University of Derby
creators.bio: Psychologist who runs the Nature Connectedness Research Group and designs simple interventions such as noticing 'three good things in nature'.
creators.why: His five pathways (contact, emotion, compassion, meaning, beauty) tell designers what kind of engagement actually builds connection.
creators.role_zh: 德比大学人因与自然联结教授
creators.bio_zh: 心理学家，领导自然联结研究组，设计诸如“每天记下自然中的三件好事”这类简单干预。
creators.why_zh: 他提出的五条路径（感官接触、情感、同情、意义、美）告诉设计者哪种参与真正能建立联结。

creators.name: Michael D. Jones
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, Brigham Young University
creators.bio: HCI researcher who studies computing on trails, rivers and mountains.
creators.why: He co-organised the HCI Outdoors community and edited its book.
creators.role_zh: 杨百翰大学计算机科学教授
creators.bio_zh: HCI 研究者，研究步道、河流与山地中的计算。
creators.why_zh: 他共同发起了 HCI Outdoors 社群，并主编了同名书籍。

creators.name: Jonna Häkkilä
creators.role: Professor of Industrial Design, University of Lapland
creators.bio: Interaction designer working in Finnish Lapland on wearables, displays and technology for nature and the Arctic.
creators.why: Her HOBBIT app showed that a hiking app can be designed to keep people away from other people.
creators.role_zh: 拉普兰大学工业设计教授
creators.bio_zh: 在芬兰拉普兰工作的交互设计师，研究可穿戴、显示设备以及面向自然和北极的技术。
creators.why_zh: 她的 HOBBIT 应用表明，徒步应用也可以被设计来帮人避开人群。

creators.name: Jennifer Preece
creators.role: Professor and Dean Emerita, College of Information Studies, University of Maryland
creators.bio: HCI pioneer who turned to biodiversity citizen science, including the NatureNet and Floracaching projects.
creators.why: She set out a research agenda for HCI in citizen science.
creators.role_zh: 马里兰大学信息学院荣休教授及前院长
creators.bio_zh: HCI 先驱，后转向生物多样性公民科学，参与 NatureNet、Floracaching 等项目。
creators.why_zh: 她为公民科学中的 HCI 研究提出了议程。

creators.name: Anne Bowser
creators.role: Deputy Director and Chief Innovation Officer, Wilson Center (former PhD student at the University of Maryland)
creators.bio: Researcher on citizen science, games and open data.
creators.why: Her Floracaching game used geocaching mechanics to recruit plant phenology volunteers.
creators.role_zh: 威尔逊中心副主任兼首席创新官（曾为马里兰大学博士生）
creators.bio_zh: 研究公民科学、游戏与开放数据。
creators.why_zh: 她的 Floracaching 游戏借用地理寻宝的机制招募植物物候志愿者。

creators.name: Andrea Wiggins
creators.role: Associate Professor of Information Systems, University of Nebraska Omaha
creators.bio: Information scientist who studies how citizen science projects are organised and how they manage data.
creators.why: Her typology is the common map of citizen science project types.
creators.role_zh: 内布拉斯加大学奥马哈分校信息系统副教授
creators.bio_zh: 信息科学家，研究公民科学项目如何组织与管理数据。
creators.why_zh: 她的分类法是公民科学项目类型的通用地图。

creators.name: Rick Bonney
creators.role: Director Emeritus of Public Engagement in Science, Cornell Lab of Ornithology
creators.bio: Pioneer of bird-focused public participation projects at the Cornell Lab.
creators.why: He helped define 'citizen science' as a model in which the public collects data for real research.
creators.role_zh: 康奈尔鸟类学实验室公众科学参与部荣休主任
creators.bio_zh: 康奈尔鸟类学实验室鸟类公众参与项目的开创者。
creators.why_zh: 他帮助把“公民科学”定义为公众为真实科研采集数据的模式。

creators.name: Jakob von Uexküll
creators.role: Biologist (1864–1944), founder of the Institut für Umweltforschung, University of Hamburg
creators.bio: Baltic German biologist who described how each animal lives inside its own perceptual world.
creators.why: His concept of Umwelt is the root idea of every design that lets humans sense like another species.
creators.role_zh: 生物学家（1864–1944），汉堡大学环境研究所创立者
creators.bio_zh: 波罗的海德裔生物学家，描述了每种动物如何生活在自己的感知世界里。
creators.why_zh: 他的“环世界”（Umwelt）概念，是所有让人像其他物种一样感知的设计的源头。

creators.name: Ed Yong
creators.role: Science journalist; former staff writer at The Atlantic
creators.bio: Pulitzer Prize-winning science writer on animals, microbes and pandemics.
creators.why: His book brought the idea of Umwelt to a broad audience with concrete sensory examples.
creators.role_zh: 科学记者，前《大西洋月刊》撰稿人
creators.bio_zh: 普利策奖得主科学作家，写动物、微生物与疫情。
creators.why_zh: 他的书用具体的感官案例，把“环世界”带给了大众读者。

creators.name: Thomas Nagel
creators.role: University Professor of Philosophy and Law Emeritus, New York University
creators.bio: Philosopher of mind, ethics and political philosophy.
creators.why: His bat essay marks the limit every umwelt experience runs into: we can simulate another animal's senses but not its experience.
creators.role_zh: 纽约大学哲学与法学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 心灵哲学、伦理学和政治哲学领域的哲学家。
creators.why_zh: 他关于蝙蝠的文章指出了所有“环世界”体验都会遇到的边界：我们能模拟动物的感官，却无法获得它的体验。

creators.name: Bryan C. Pijanowski
creators.role: Professor of Landscape Ecology and director of the Center for Global Soundscapes, Purdue University
creators.bio: Landscape ecologist who records soundscapes around the world as ecological data.
creators.why: He framed soundscape ecology as a science, giving nature listening tools a scientific basis.
creators.role_zh: 普渡大学景观生态学教授、全球声景中心主任
creators.bio_zh: 景观生态学家，在世界各地把声景作为生态数据来录制。
creators.why_zh: 他把声景生态学确立为一门科学，为自然聆听工具提供了科学基础。

creators.name: Oscar Tomico
creators.role: Head of the Design Engineering Master, Elisava Barcelona; Associate Professor, Eindhoven University of Technology
creators.bio: Design researcher working on soft wearables, first-person methods and nature-entangled design.
creators.why: He gathered a shared repository of methods for designing with and from nature.
creators.role_zh: Elisava 巴塞罗那设计工程硕士项目负责人，埃因霍温理工大学副教授
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究柔性可穿戴、第一人称方法与“与自然纠缠的设计”。
creators.why_zh: 他汇集了一个与自然共同设计、从自然出发设计的方法库。
creators.based_zh: 巴塞罗那，西班牙 / 埃因霍温，荷兰

creators.name: Jon E. Froehlich
creators.role: Professor, Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering, University of Washington; director of the Makeability Lab
creators.bio: HCI researcher on sustainability sensing, accessibility and urban data.
creators.why: His eco-feedback survey and UbiGreen app set the design space for making environmental impact visible on personal devices.
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学 Paul G. Allen 计算机科学与工程学院教授，Makeability Lab 主任
creators.bio_zh: HCI 研究者，研究可持续感知、无障碍与城市数据。
creators.why_zh: 他的生态反馈综述与 UbiGreen 应用，界定了在个人设备上让环境影响可见的设计空间。

creators.name: Margot Brereton
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, Queensland University of Technology (QUT)
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher whose QUT group builds bird-listening devices, ecoacoustic citizen science tools and garden technologies with communities.
creators.why: Her lab is one of the most sustained HCI programmes on nature connection, from the Ambient Birdhouse to Networked Gardens.
creators.role_zh: 昆士兰科技大学交互设计教授
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，她在昆士兰科技大学的团队与社区一起开发听鸟设备、生态声学公民科学工具和园艺技术。
creators.why_zh: 从 Ambient Birdhouse 到 Networked Gardens，她的实验室是 HCI 中持续最久的自然联结研究项目之一。

creators.name: Ferran Altarriba Bertran
creators.role: Researcher, Escola Universitària ERAM (University of Girona); formerly Tampere University Gamification Group
creators.bio: Play designer who co-designs technology 'from the wild', with forests, rivers and the people who use them.
creators.why: He argues for joyful, playful forest technology instead of purely informational nature apps.
creators.role_zh: 赫罗纳大学 ERAM 学院研究者，曾在坦佩雷大学游戏化研究组
creators.bio_zh: 游戏设计研究者，与森林、河流以及使用它们的人一起“从野外出发”共同设计技术。
creators.why_zh: 他主张做让人快乐、好玩的森林技术，而不只是信息型的自然应用。

creators.name: Xiaoge Wang
creators.role: Interaction design researcher
creators.bio: Designer of Nature Jar, a tangible device that brings outdoor nature into the home.
creators.why: Her work shows a small ambient object as a daily channel for nature connectedness.
creators.role_zh: 交互设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: Nature Jar 的设计者，这是一个把户外自然带进家中的实体装置。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品把一个小型环境物件做成日常的自然联结通道。

creators.name: Marta Galvão Ferreira
creators.role: Researcher, Interactive Technologies Institute (ITI/LARSyS), Madeira
creators.bio: Researcher in learning sciences and design who uses drawing and walking to help people make sense of nature.
creators.why: Her 'data drawings' and nature-walk pedagogy offer low-tech methods for human–nature sensemaking.
creators.role_zh: 马德拉交互技术研究所（ITI/LARSyS）研究者
creators.bio_zh: 学习科学与设计研究者，用绘画和行走帮助人理解自然。
creators.why_zh: 她的“数据绘画”和自然漫步教学法提供了低技术的人与自然意义建构方法。

creators.name: Seekrtech
creators.role: App developer, maker of Forest
creators.bio: Taiwanese studio that makes focus and habit apps built around growing plants.
creators.why: Forest links a virtual tree to real tree planting, turning screen time into a nature metaphor.
creators.role_zh: 应用开发公司，Forest 的开发者
creators.bio_zh: 台湾应用工作室，开发以种植植物为核心的专注与习惯应用。
creators.why_zh: Forest 把虚拟树与真实植树相连，把屏幕时间变成一个自然隐喻。

creators.name: Katie Paterson
creators.role: Visual artist
creators.bio: Scottish artist whose works deal with deep time, distance and scale, from glaciers to dead stars.
creators.why: She makes geological and forest time into something a person can call, listen to or wait for.
creators.role_zh: 视觉艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 苏格兰艺术家，作品处理深时、距离与尺度，从冰川到死亡的恒星。
creators.why_zh: 她把地质时间与森林时间变成人可以拨打、聆听或等待的东西。

creators.name: Hildegard Westerkamp
creators.role: Composer, radio artist and sound ecologist; member of the World Soundscape Project
creators.bio: Composer who shaped soundscape composition and the practice of the soundwalk.
creators.why: Her soundwalks train attention to the environment through listening.
creators.role_zh: 作曲家、电台艺术家、声音生态学者，World Soundscape Project 成员
creators.bio_zh: 塑造了声景作曲与“声音漫步”实践的作曲家。
creators.why_zh: 她的声音漫步通过聆听训练人对环境的注意。

creators.name: explore.org
creators.role: Live nature camera network of the Annenberg Foundation
creators.bio: Nonprofit that streams dozens of live cameras from bear rivers, eagle nests and reefs.
creators.why: It is the largest example of the 'webcam nature' that Peter Kahn studied.
creators.role_zh: Annenberg 基金会旗下的自然直播网络
creators.bio_zh: 非营利机构，直播熊河、鹰巢与珊瑚礁等数十个现场镜头。
creators.why_zh: 它是 Peter Kahn 研究的“网络摄像头自然”最大规模的实例。

creators.name: Roger Payne
creators.role: Biologist (1935–2023), founder of Ocean Alliance
creators.bio: Whale biologist who, with Scott McVay, discovered that humpback whales sing.
creators.why: His album showed how a recording can change how a whole public relates to a species.
creators.role_zh: 生物学家（1935–2023），Ocean Alliance 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 鲸类生物学家，与 Scott McVay 一起发现座头鲸会“唱歌”。
creators.why_zh: 他的唱片证明，一段录音能改变整个公众对一个物种的态度。

creators.name: Yvonne Rogers
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, University College London; director of the UCL Interaction Centre
creators.bio: HCI researcher known for ubiquitous computing in the wild and for the textbook Interaction Design.
creators.why: Ambient Wood was one of the first projects to augment a real woodland for learning.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学学院交互设计教授，UCL 交互中心主任
creators.bio_zh: HCI 研究者，以“野外”普适计算研究和《交互设计》教材闻名。
creators.why_zh: Ambient Wood 是最早为学习而增强真实林地的项目之一。

creators.name: Keri Facer
creators.role: Professor of Educational and Social Futures, University of Bristol; formerly Research Director at Futurelab
creators.bio: Education researcher who led early mobile learning experiments at Futurelab.
creators.why: Savannah had children play lions on a school field, learning animal behaviour through their own bodies.
creators.role_zh: 布里斯托大学教育与社会未来教授，曾任 Futurelab 研究主任
creators.bio_zh: 教育研究者，在 Futurelab 主导了早期移动学习实验。
creators.why_zh: Savannah 让孩子在学校操场上扮演狮子，用身体学习动物行为。

creators.name: Eric Klopfer
creators.role: Professor and director of the Scheller Teacher Education Program, MIT
creators.bio: Learning scientist who builds simulations and augmented reality games for science education.
creators.why: Environmental Detectives was an early location-based AR game played on a real watershed.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院教授，Scheller 教师教育项目主任
creators.bio_zh: 学习科学家，为科学教育开发模拟和增强现实游戏。
creators.why_zh: Environmental Detectives 是早期在真实流域中玩的基于位置的 AR 游戏。

creators.name: William Odom
creators.role: Associate Professor, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University; Everyday Design Studio
creators.bio: Design researcher who builds slow, long-term technologies for everyday life.
creators.why: Capra brings slow technology to hiking, helping people revisit trails over years.
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学交互艺术与技术学院副教授，Everyday Design Studio
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，为日常生活制作“慢”的、长期使用的技术。
creators.why_zh: Capra 把慢技术带到徒步中，帮助人多年后重温走过的步道。

creators.name: Jon Back
creators.role: Senior Lecturer, Department of Informatics and Media, Uppsala University
creators.bio: Game and play researcher who designs digital play for forests and playgrounds.
creators.why: He designs hybrid play that keeps children's attention on the real woods.
creators.role_zh: 乌普萨拉大学信息学与媒体系高级讲师
creators.bio_zh: 游戏研究者，为森林和游乐场设计数字游戏。
creators.why_zh: 他设计混合式游戏，让孩子的注意力留在真实的树林中。

creators.name: Geocaching HQ (Groundspeak)
creators.role: Company that runs geocaching.com
creators.bio: Seattle company that has run the main geocaching platform since 2000.
creators.why: Geocaching turned GPS into an excuse to go outdoors and look closely at places.
creators.role_zh: 运营 geocaching.com 的公司
creators.bio_zh: 西雅图公司，自 2000 年起运营主要的地理寻宝平台。
creators.why_zh: 地理寻宝把 GPS 变成走出户外、细看地方的理由。

creators.name: Niantic
creators.role: Augmented reality game company
creators.bio: Maker of location-based AR games including Ingress and Pokémon Go.
creators.why: Pokémon Go sent millions of people outdoors and started a debate on games for conservation.
creators.role_zh: 增强现实游戏公司
creators.bio_zh: 开发 Ingress、Pokémon Go 等基于位置的 AR 游戏的公司。
creators.why_zh: Pokémon Go 让数百万人走出户外，也引发了“游戏能否服务自然保护”的讨论。

creators.name: PeakFinder
creators.role: App developer (Fabio Soldati)
creators.bio: Swiss developer of a mountain-identification app with an offline database of peaks.
creators.why: PeakFinder is a plain example of AR that names the landscape in front of you.
creators.role_zh: 应用开发者（Fabio Soldati）
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士开发者，其山峰识别应用带有离线山峰数据库。
creators.why_zh: PeakFinder 是 AR 为眼前风景命名的朴素案例。

creators.name: Bluebrain
creators.role: Music duo (Hays and Ryan Holladay)
creators.bio: Brothers who make location-aware albums that change as listeners walk through a place.
creators.why: Their Central Park album made a park walk into a composition.
creators.role_zh: 音乐二人组（Hays 与 Ryan Holladay）
creators.bio_zh: 兄弟二人，制作随听众在某地行走而变化的位置感知专辑。
creators.why_zh: 他们的中央公园专辑把公园漫步变成了一首作品。

creators.name: Janet Cardiff & George Bures Miller
creators.role: Artist duo working with sound installations and audio walks
creators.bio: Canadian artists known for binaural audio walks and multi-speaker installations.
creators.why: Their forest works layer recorded sound over a real forest so listeners hear it anew.
creators.role_zh: 以声音装置和音频漫步创作的艺术家二人组
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家，以双耳录音漫步与多扬声器装置闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他们的森林作品把录音叠加在真实森林上，让听者重新听见它。
creators.based_zh: 格林德罗德，加拿大 / 柏林，德国

creators.name: Andrew Quitmeyer
creators.role: Founder of Digital Naturalism Laboratories (Dinalab); former Assistant Professor, National University of Singapore
creators.bio: Designer who builds field-hacked electronics with biologists in the jungle.
creators.why: His 'digital naturalism' asks how computing can support curiosity-driven exploration of wild places.
creators.role_zh: Digital Naturalism Laboratories（Dinalab）创始人，前新加坡国立大学助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 设计师，与生物学家一起在丛林里现场改造电子设备。
creators.why_zh: 他的“数字博物学”追问计算如何支撑出于好奇的野外探索。

creators.name: iNaturalist
creators.role: Nonprofit nature observation network (formerly a joint initiative of the California Academy of Sciences and National Geographic Society)
creators.bio: Online community and app where people share observations of organisms and help identify them.
creators.why: It shows how a social network plus computer vision can turn casual noticing into research-grade biodiversity data.
creators.role_zh: 非营利自然观察网络（曾为加州科学院与美国国家地理学会的联合项目）
creators.bio_zh: 在线社区与应用，人们在此分享生物观察并协助鉴定。
creators.why_zh: 它说明社交网络加上计算机视觉，可以把随意的观察变成科研级的生物多样性数据。

creators.name: National Audubon Society
creators.role: Bird conservation nonprofit
creators.bio: US conservation organisation founded in 1905.
creators.why: Its Christmas Bird Count is the longest-running citizen science survey.
creators.role_zh: 鸟类保护非营利组织
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 1905 年的美国保护组织。
creators.why_zh: 它的圣诞鸟类调查是持续时间最长的公民科学调查。

creators.name: Zooniverse
creators.role: People-powered research platform of the University of Oxford, Adler Planetarium and University of Minnesota
creators.bio: Platform where volunteers classify images and sounds for research projects.
creators.why: Its camera-trap projects let anyone look through the lens of a wildlife survey from home.
creators.role_zh: 牛津大学、阿德勒天文馆与明尼苏达大学共同运营的公众参与科研平台
creators.bio_zh: 志愿者为科研项目分类图像与声音的平台。
creators.why_zh: 它的相机陷阱项目让任何人都能在家中透过野生动物调查的镜头观看。
creators.based_zh: 牛津，英国 / 芝加哥，美国

creators.name: NSF NOIRLab (Globe at Night)
creators.role: US national optical-infrared astronomy centre
creators.bio: Astronomy centre that runs the Globe at Night light-pollution campaign.
creators.why: Globe at Night makes the night sky a shared environmental measurement.
creators.role_zh: 美国国家光学-红外天文中心
creators.bio_zh: 运营 Globe at Night 光污染观测活动的天文中心。
creators.why_zh: Globe at Night 把夜空变成一项共同的环境测量。

creators.name: Budburst (Chicago Botanic Garden)
creators.role: Plant phenology citizen science programme
creators.bio: Programme where volunteers record when plants leaf, flower and fruit.
creators.why: It turns the seasonal life of plants into shared climate data.
creators.role_zh: 植物物候公民科学项目
creators.bio_zh: 志愿者记录植物何时发叶、开花、结果的项目。
creators.why_zh: 它把植物的季节生活变成共享的气候数据。

creators.name: Pl@ntNet
creators.role: Plant identification project of CIRAD, INRAE, Inria and IRD
creators.bio: French research consortium behind one of the largest plant identification apps.
creators.why: Every identification also becomes a botanical observation.
creators.role_zh: 由 CIRAD、INRAE、Inria 与 IRD 共同开展的植物识别项目
creators.bio_zh: 法国研究联盟，开发了最大的植物识别应用之一。
creators.why_zh: 每一次识别同时也是一条植物学观测记录。

creators.name: Peter N. Belhumeur
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, Columbia University
creators.bio: Computer vision researcher who led Leafsnap with the University of Maryland and the Smithsonian.
creators.why: Leafsnap was the first widely used app to identify plants from a photo.
creators.role_zh: 哥伦比亚大学计算机科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机视觉研究者，与马里兰大学和史密森尼学会共同开发 Leafsnap。
creators.why_zh: Leafsnap 是首个被广泛使用的拍照识别植物应用。

creators.name: Mosquito Alert
creators.role: Citizen science project of CEAB-CSIC, CREAF, UPF and ICREA
creators.bio: Spanish project that tracks invasive, disease-carrying mosquitoes with smartphone reports.
creators.why: It shows citizen science applied to organisms people would rather avoid.
creators.role_zh: 由 CEAB-CSIC、CREAF、UPF 与 ICREA 合作的公民科学项目
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙项目，通过手机上报追踪入侵性、传播疾病的蚊子。
creators.why_zh: 它展示了公民科学如何用于人们宁愿回避的生物。

creators.name: California Academy of Sciences
creators.role: Natural history museum and research institute
creators.bio: Museum that co-founded the City Nature Challenge and hosted iNaturalist.
creators.why: It turned urban bioblitzes into a global competition between cities.
creators.role_zh: 自然历史博物馆与研究机构
creators.bio_zh: 共同发起城市自然挑战赛并曾托管 iNaturalist 的博物馆。
creators.why_zh: 它把城市生物闪电调查变成了城市之间的全球竞赛。

creators.name: Sam Droege
creators.role: Wildlife biologist, USGS Patuxent Wildlife Research Center
creators.bio: Biologist known for native bee monitoring and macro photography.
creators.why: He co-organised the first BioBlitz in 1996.
creators.role_zh: 美国地质调查局 Patuxent 野生动物研究中心生物学家
creators.bio_zh: 以本土蜜蜂监测和微距摄影闻名的生物学家。
creators.why_zh: 他共同组织了 1996 年的第一次 BioBlitz。

creators.name: Wildlife Insights
creators.role: Camera-trap data platform of Conservation International, WWF, WCS, ZSL, Smithsonian and Google
creators.bio: Cloud platform that uses AI to identify animals in camera-trap photos.
creators.why: It moves wildlife monitoring from months of manual tagging to near real time.
creators.role_zh: 由保护国际、WWF、WCS、ZSL、史密森尼学会与 Google 等共建的相机陷阱数据平台
creators.bio_zh: 用 AI 识别相机陷阱照片中动物的云平台。
creators.why_zh: 它把野生动物监测从数月的人工标注变成接近实时。

creators.name: MBARI
creators.role: Monterey Bay Aquarium Research Institute
creators.bio: Ocean research institute behind FathomNet and Ocean Vision AI.
creators.why: It invites the public to label deep-sea imagery for AI.
creators.role_zh: 蒙特雷湾水族馆研究所
creators.bio_zh: 开发 FathomNet 与 Ocean Vision AI 的海洋研究机构。
creators.why_zh: 它邀请公众为 AI 标注深海影像。

creators.name: GROW Observatory
creators.role: EU Horizon 2020 citizen science project led by the University of Dundee
creators.bio: Project in which growers across Europe placed soil sensors to validate satellite soil-moisture data.
creators.why: It joined food growing, soil care and climate science.
creators.role_zh: 由邓迪大学牵头的欧盟 Horizon 2020 公民科学项目
creators.bio_zh: 欧洲各地种植者放置土壤传感器、校验卫星土壤湿度数据的项目。
creators.why_zh: 它把种植、土壤照护与气候科学连在一起。

creators.name: Safecast
creators.role: Volunteer environmental monitoring nonprofit
creators.bio: Group founded after the 2011 Fukushima disaster that builds open radiation and air sensors.
creators.why: It showed that citizens can produce trusted environmental data at scale.
creators.role_zh: 志愿者环境监测非营利组织
creators.bio_zh: 2011 年福岛核事故后成立，开发开源辐射与空气传感器的团体。
creators.why_zh: 它证明公民能够大规模产出可信的环境数据。
creators.based_zh: 东京，日本 / 洛杉矶，美国

creators.name: Public Lab
creators.role: Public Laboratory for Open Technology and Science
creators.bio: Community that develops low-cost tools for environmental investigation.
creators.why: Its balloon maps made aerial evidence of pollution available to affected communities.
creators.role_zh: 开放技术与科学公共实验室
creators.bio_zh: 开发低成本环境调查工具的社群。
creators.why_zh: 它的气球航拍让受影响社区也能获得污染的航拍证据。

creators.name: Fab Lab Barcelona
creators.role: Digital fabrication lab at the Institute for Advanced Architecture of Catalonia (IAAC)
creators.bio: Lab that develops open hardware for cities, including the Smart Citizen Kit.
creators.why: It puts environmental sensing in residents' hands.
creators.role_zh: 加泰罗尼亚高等建筑研究院（IAAC）的数字制造实验室
creators.bio_zh: 为城市开发开源硬件的实验室，包括 Smart Citizen Kit。
creators.why_zh: 它把环境感知交到居民手中。

creators.name: Sensor.Community
creators.role: Open environmental data network (formerly Luftdaten.info, OK Lab Stuttgart)
creators.bio: Volunteer network of home-built particulate sensors.
creators.why: It is one of the largest citizen air-quality networks in the world.
creators.role_zh: 开放环境数据网络（原 Luftdaten.info，OK Lab Stuttgart）
creators.bio_zh: 由自制颗粒物传感器组成的志愿者网络。
creators.why_zh: 它是世界上最大的公民空气质量网络之一。

creators.name: FarmBot
creators.role: Open-source farming robot company (founded by Rory Aronson)
creators.bio: Company that makes an open-source CNC robot for garden beds.
creators.why: FarmBot makes a garden programmable, raising questions about care and automation.
creators.role_zh: 开源种植机器人公司（Rory Aronson 创立）
creators.bio_zh: 制造用于菜畦的开源数控机器人的公司。
creators.why_zh: FarmBot 让菜园可编程，也引出关于照料与自动化的问题。
creators.based_zh: 圣路易斯奥比斯波，美国

creators.name: Click & Grow
creators.role: Indoor gardening company
creators.bio: Estonian company that makes self-watering smart gardens with seed pods.
creators.why: It turns growing food indoors into a near-zero-skill appliance.
creators.role_zh: 室内园艺公司
creators.bio_zh: 爱沙尼亚公司，生产带种子胶囊的自动浇水智能花园。
creators.why_zh: 它把室内种菜变成几乎不需技能的家电。

creators.name: Parrot
creators.role: Consumer electronics and drone company
creators.bio: French company known for drones and connected devices.
creators.why: Its Flower Power sensor was an early consumer plant-care IoT device.
creators.role_zh: 消费电子与无人机公司
creators.bio_zh: 以无人机和联网设备闻名的法国公司。
creators.why_zh: 它的 Flower Power 传感器是早期面向消费者的植物照护物联网设备。

creators.name: Mu Design
creators.role: Product design studio
creators.bio: Luxembourg studio that designed Lua, a planter with a face.
creators.why: Lua makes plant needs legible through emotion.
creators.role_zh: 产品设计工作室
creators.bio_zh: 设计了带表情的花盆 Lua 的卢森堡工作室。
creators.why_zh: Lua 用情绪让植物的需求变得可读。

creators.name: Daniela Rus
creators.role: Professor and director of the Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CSAIL), MIT
creators.bio: Roboticist working on distributed and soft robots.
creators.why: Her lab's robot garden explored robots that tend plants on their own schedule.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院教授，计算机科学与人工智能实验室（CSAIL）主任
creators.bio_zh: 研究分布式与软体机器人的机器人学家。
creators.why_zh: 她实验室的机器人花园探索了按植物节奏照料植物的机器人。

creators.name: Caleb Harper
creators.role: Founder of the MIT Media Lab Open Agriculture Initiative (2015–2020)
creators.bio: Architect-turned-researcher who promoted 'digital recipes' for growing food.
creators.why: The Food Computer is both a vision of programmable climates and a cautionary tale about over-promising.
creators.role_zh: MIT 媒体实验室开放农业计划创始人（2015–2020）
creators.bio_zh: 由建筑师转为研究者，推广种植食物的“数字配方”。
creators.why_zh: Food Computer 既是可编程气候的愿景，也是一个过度承诺的警示。

creators.name: Hanuma Teja Maddali
creators.role: HCI researcher, University of Maryland (with Amanda Lazar)
creators.bio: Researcher who studies how older adults and novices share gardening skills, and how XR could support them.
creators.why: His work treats gardening as a social skill, not only a technical one.
creators.role_zh: 马里兰大学 HCI 研究者（与 Amanda Lazar 合作）
creators.bio_zh: 研究老年人与新手如何分享园艺技能，以及 XR 如何支持他们。
creators.why_zh: 他的研究把园艺视为一种社会技能，而不仅是技术技能。

creators.name: Ilhan Aslan
creators.role: Associate Professor, Department of Computer Science, Aalborg University (formerly University of Augsburg)
creators.bio: HCI researcher on somaesthetics, implicit interaction and human–plant interfaces.
creators.why: He studies how a houseplant can become a quiet interface in the smart home.
creators.role_zh: 奥尔堡大学计算机科学系副教授（曾在奥格斯堡大学）
creators.bio_zh: 研究身体美学、隐式交互与人-植物界面的 HCI 研究者。
creators.why_zh: 他研究盆栽如何成为智能家居中安静的界面。

creators.name: Plantix (PEAT)
creators.role: Agritech company, Progressive Environmental & Agricultural Technologies
creators.bio: Company behind a crop-disease diagnosis app used by millions of smallholder farmers.
creators.why: It puts plant pathology expertise in a phone camera.
creators.role_zh: 农业科技公司 Progressive Environmental & Agricultural Technologies
creators.bio_zh: 开发作物病害诊断应用的公司，其应用被数百万小农户使用。
creators.why_zh: 它把植物病理学的专业知识放进了手机镜头里。
creators.based_zh: 柏林，德国 / 印多尔，印度

creators.name: Neil Harbisson
creators.role: Cyborg artist; co-founder of the Cyborg Foundation and Cyborg Arts
creators.bio: Artist born with achromatopsia who hears colour through an antenna implanted in his skull.
creators.why: He treats new senses, including ultraviolet and infrared, as a form of art and of identity.
creators.role_zh: 赛博格艺术家，Cyborg Foundation 与 Cyborg Arts 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 天生全色盲的艺术家，通过植入颅骨的天线“听见”颜色。
creators.why_zh: 他把新的感官（包括紫外线与红外线）视为艺术和身份的一部分。

creators.name: Moon Ribas
creators.role: Cyborg artist and choreographer; co-founder of the Cyborg Foundation
creators.bio: Dancer who felt earthquakes worldwide through online seismic sensors implanted in her body.
creators.why: Her Seismic Sense links a human body to the movement of the planet.
creators.role_zh: 赛博格艺术家、编舞家，Cyborg Foundation 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 舞者，通过植入体内并联网的地震传感器感受全球地震。
creators.why_zh: 她的“地震感官”把人的身体与地球的运动连接起来。

creators.name: Cyborg Nest
creators.role: Sense-extension startup co-founded by Liviu Babitz and Scott Cohen
creators.bio: Company that sold North Sense, a body-worn device that vibrates when facing north.
creators.why: It tried to make a new, animal-like sense a consumer product.
creators.role_zh: 由 Liviu Babitz 与 Scott Cohen 共同创立的感官延伸初创公司
creators.bio_zh: 推出 North Sense 的公司，这是一种面朝北方时会振动的贴身设备。
creators.why_zh: 它尝试把一种类似动物的新感官做成消费产品。

creators.name: Peter König
creators.role: Professor of Neurobiopsychology, Institute of Cognitive Science, University of Osnabrück; co-founder of feelSpace
creators.bio: Cognitive scientist who studies sensory augmentation.
creators.why: His feelSpace belt tested whether humans can learn a magnetic sense like migratory birds.
creators.role_zh: 奥斯纳布吕克大学认知科学研究所神经生物心理学教授，feelSpace 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 研究感官增强的认知科学家。
creators.why_zh: 他的 feelSpace 腰带检验了人能否像候鸟一样学会磁感。

creators.name: Marcus Maeder
creators.role: Sound artist and researcher, Institute for Computer Music and Sound Technology, Zurich University of the Arts
creators.bio: Sound artist and acoustic ecologist who records trees, soils and ecosystems.
creators.why: He makes the inaudible physiology of trees and soils audible.
creators.role_zh: 苏黎世艺术大学计算机音乐与声音技术研究所声音艺术家与研究者
creators.bio_zh: 声音艺术家与声学生态学者，录制树木、土壤与生态系统。
creators.why_zh: 他让树木与土壤听不见的生理过程变得可听。

creators.name: Lisa L. Townsend
creators.role: HCI researcher, LMU Munich (with Sven Mayer)
creators.bio: Researcher on virtual reality and nature connectedness.
creators.why: Her VR study tests whether 'becoming a tree' can raise nature connectedness.
creators.role_zh: 慕尼黑大学 HCI 研究者（与 Sven Mayer 合作）
creators.bio_zh: 研究虚拟现实与自然联结。
creators.why_zh: 她的 VR 研究检验“成为一棵树”能否提升自然联结。

creators.name: Thomas Thwaites
creators.role: Designer
creators.bio: Designer known for The Toaster Project and GoatMan.
creators.why: He used prosthetics and neuroscience to try to take a holiday from being human.
creators.role_zh: 设计师
creators.bio_zh: 以《烤面包机计划》和《山羊人》闻名的设计师。
creators.why_zh: 他借助假肢和神经科学，尝试“从做人中休假”。

creators.name: Eric Paulos
creators.role: Professor of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences, UC Berkeley; director of the Hybrid Ecologies Lab
creators.bio: HCI researcher who started citizen and participatory environmental sensing in HCI.
creators.why: His projects put air sensors on street sweepers, balloons and phones.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校电子工程与计算机科学教授，Hybrid Ecologies Lab 主任
creators.bio_zh: 在 HCI 中开创了公民参与式环境感知研究。
creators.why_zh: 他的项目把空气传感器装到清扫车、气球和手机上。

creators.name: CMU CREATE Lab
creators.role: Community Robotics, Education and Technology Empowerment Lab, Carnegie Mellon University (Illah Nourbakhsh, Yen-Chia Hsu)
creators.bio: Lab that builds tools for communities to document air pollution.
creators.why: Smell Pittsburgh uses the human nose as a pollution sensor.
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学社区机器人、教育与技术赋能实验室（Illah Nourbakhsh、Yen-Chia Hsu）
creators.bio_zh: 为社区记录空气污染开发工具的实验室。
creators.why_zh: Smell Pittsburgh 把人的鼻子当作污染传感器。

creators.name: Eleni Margariti
creators.role: HCI researcher, Open Lab, Newcastle University / Northumbria University
creators.bio: Designer of ActuAir, a shape-changing wall that shows indoor air quality.
creators.why: Her work makes invisible air legible through form.
creators.role_zh: 纽卡斯尔大学 Open Lab / 诺森比亚大学 HCI 研究者
creators.bio_zh: ActuAir 的设计者，这是一面显示室内空气质量的变形墙。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究用形态让看不见的空气变得可读。

creators.name: Michael Pinsky
creators.role: Artist
creators.bio: British artist who makes public installations about air, water and urban space.
creators.why: Pollution Pods let visitors breathe the air of other cities.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，创作关于空气、水与城市空间的公共装置。
creators.why_zh: 《污染舱》让观众呼吸其他城市的空气。

creators.name: Ed Hawkins
creators.role: Professor of Climate Science, University of Reading
creators.bio: Climate scientist who created the warming stripes and climate spiral graphics.
creators.why: He showed that the simplest data graphic can become a shared cultural symbol.
creators.role_zh: 雷丁大学气候科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 创作了“变暖条纹”和“气候螺旋”图形的气候科学家。
creators.why_zh: 他证明最简单的数据图形也能成为共享的文化符号。

creators.name: Climate Clock (Gan Golan & Andrew Boyd)
creators.role: Artist-activist project
creators.bio: Project by artists Gan Golan and Andrew Boyd that installs public countdown clocks for climate deadlines.
creators.why: It makes a carbon budget readable as time.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家-行动者项目
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家 Gan Golan 与 Andrew Boyd 发起的项目，在公共空间安装气候截止期限倒计时钟。
creators.why_zh: 它把碳预算变成可读的时间。

creators.name: Daniel Crawford
creators.role: Data sonification artist (studied at the University of Minnesota)
creators.bio: Sonifier who turns climate data into compositions for string instruments.
creators.why: His cello piece lets audiences hear 130 years of warming.
creators.role_zh: 数据可听化艺术家（曾就读于明尼苏达大学）
creators.bio_zh: 把气候数据转化为弦乐作品的可听化创作者。
creators.why_zh: 他的大提琴作品让听众听见 130 年的变暖。

creators.name: Andrea Polli
creators.role: Professor of Art and Ecology, University of New Mexico
creators.bio: Environmental artist who works with air, weather and climate data.
creators.why: Particle Falls shows fine particulates as a waterfall of light on a building.
creators.role_zh: 新墨西哥大学艺术与生态教授
creators.bio_zh: 以空气、天气和气候数据创作的环境艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 《粒子瀑布》把细颗粒物显示为建筑立面上的光之瀑布。

creators.name: HeHe (Helen Evans & Heiko Hansen)
creators.role: Artist duo
creators.bio: Artists who make pollution and energy use visible in public space.
creators.why: Nuage Vert drew a green laser outline on a power plant's emissions cloud.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组
creators.bio_zh: 在公共空间让污染与能源消耗可见的艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 《绿云》用绿色激光勾勒电厂排放的烟云。

creators.name: Plume Labs
creators.role: Air-quality data company (acquired by AccuWeather in 2022)
creators.bio: Company that forecast air pollution and made the Flow personal sensor.
creators.why: Pigeon Air Patrol put pollution sensors on London racing pigeons.
creators.role_zh: 空气质量数据公司（2022 年被 AccuWeather 收购）
creators.bio_zh: 预测空气污染并推出 Flow 个人传感器的公司。
creators.why_zh: “鸽子空气巡逻”把污染传感器装到了伦敦的赛鸽身上。

creators.name: Julian Oliver
creators.role: Critical engineer and artist
creators.bio: New Zealand artist and co-author of the Critical Engineering Manifesto.
creators.why: Harvest ties computation directly to wind and to climate research funding.
creators.role_zh: 批判性工程师与艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 新西兰艺术家，《批判性工程宣言》的合著者。
creators.why_zh: 《收获》把计算直接与风以及气候研究资金挂钩。

creators.name: Nathalie Miebach
creators.role: Artist
creators.bio: Artist who weaves weather and ocean data into sculptures and musical scores.
creators.why: She translates storms into objects you can walk around and play.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 把天气与海洋数据编织成雕塑与乐谱的艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 她把风暴翻译成可以绕行观看、也可以演奏的物件。

creators.name: Ecosia
creators.role: Search engine that funds tree planting
creators.bio: Berlin company that spends its profits on tree planting and climate projects.
creators.why: It turns ordinary web searches into a visible count of trees.
creators.role_zh: 用收益资助植树的搜索引擎
creators.bio_zh: 柏林公司，把利润用于植树与气候项目。
creators.why_zh: 它把日常搜索变成一个可见的植树计数。

creators.name: World Resources Institute
creators.role: Global research nonprofit
creators.bio: Research organisation that runs Global Forest Watch.
creators.why: Global Forest Watch lets anyone see forest loss almost as it happens.
creators.role_zh: 全球研究型非营利组织
creators.bio_zh: 运营 Global Forest Watch 的研究机构。
creators.why_zh: Global Forest Watch 让任何人几乎实时看到森林消失。

creators.name: MIT Senseable City Lab
creators.role: Research lab at MIT, directed by Carlo Ratti
creators.bio: Lab that studies cities through sensing and data.
creators.why: Treepedia measured street greenery from Street View images.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院研究实验室，由 Carlo Ratti 领导
creators.bio_zh: 通过感知与数据研究城市的实验室。
creators.why_zh: Treepedia 通过街景图像测量街道绿量。

creators.name: Fernanda Viégas & Martin Wattenberg
creators.role: Data visualization artists and researchers (Harvard; formerly Google PAIR)
creators.bio: Visualization duo known for artistic, public data displays.
creators.why: Their Wind Map made live weather data into a moving landscape.
creators.role_zh: 数据可视化艺术家与研究者（哈佛大学，曾在 Google PAIR）
creators.bio_zh: 以艺术化的公共数据展示闻名的可视化二人组。
creators.why_zh: 他们的《风图》把实时气象数据变成流动的风景。

creators.name: Cameron Beccario
creators.role: Software engineer and visualization maker
creators.bio: Creator of earth.nullschool.net.
creators.why: His globe shows global winds, currents and pollution as flowing particles.
creators.role_zh: 软件工程师与可视化作者
creators.bio_zh: earth.nullschool.net 的作者。
creators.why_zh: 他的地球仪用流动的粒子显示全球风场、洋流与污染。

creators.name: Shinichi Takemura
creators.role: Anthropologist and professor, Kyoto University of the Arts; creator of Tangible Earth
creators.bio: Cultural anthropologist who designs interactive globes.
creators.why: Tangible Earth let people spin and touch a live, data-rich planet.
creators.role_zh: 人类学家，京都艺术大学教授，Tangible Earth 的创作者
creators.bio_zh: 设计交互式地球仪的文化人类学家。
creators.why_zh: Tangible Earth 让人可以转动、触摸一个承载实时数据的星球。

creators.name: Atmoph
creators.role: Hardware startup
creators.bio: Kyoto company that makes a wall-mounted screen showing real-time and recorded landscape views.
creators.why: Atmoph Window is a consumer version of Kahn's plasma window.
creators.role_zh: 硬件初创公司
creators.bio_zh: 京都公司，生产可挂墙、显示实时和录制风景的屏幕。
creators.why_zh: Atmoph Window 是 Kahn“等离子屏窗景”的消费版本。

creators.name: CoeLux
creators.role: Lighting company founded on research by Paolo Di Trapani (University of Insubria)
creators.bio: Company that reproduces the look of sky and sunlight with nanoparticle optics.
creators.why: It simulates Rayleigh scattering so a basement can feel like it has a sky.
creators.role_zh: 基于 Paolo Di Trapani（因苏布里亚大学）研究创立的照明公司
creators.bio_zh: 用纳米颗粒光学再现天空与阳光外观的公司。
creators.why_zh: 它模拟瑞利散射，让地下室也像拥有一片天空。

creators.name: teamLab
creators.role: Art collective
creators.bio: Japanese art collective of artists, programmers and engineers making immersive digital installations.
creators.why: Many of its works overlay living, interactive digital nature on real forests, gardens and water.
creators.role_zh: 艺术团队
creators.bio_zh: 由艺术家、程序员与工程师组成的日本艺术团队，创作沉浸式数字装置。
creators.why_zh: 它的许多作品把鲜活、可交互的数字自然叠加在真实的森林、庭园与水面上。

creators.name: Refik Anadol
creators.role: Media artist; co-founder of Refik Anadol Studio and Dataland
creators.bio: Turkish-American artist who trains AI models on large image datasets to make fluid 'data paintings'.
creators.why: His nature works ask what a machine 'dreams' after seeing millions of images of nature.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家，Refik Anadol Studio 与 Dataland 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 土耳其裔美国艺术家，用大型图像数据集训练 AI，制作流动的“数据绘画”。
creators.why_zh: 他的自然作品追问：看过数百万张自然图像的机器会“梦见”什么。

creators.name: Random International
creators.role: Art collective founded by Hannes Koch and Florian Ortkrass
creators.bio: Studio making installations about behaviour and machines.
creators.why: Rain Room lets people walk through rain without getting wet.
creators.role_zh: 由 Hannes Koch 与 Florian Ortkrass 创立的艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 创作关于行为与机器的装置的工作室。
creators.why_zh: 《雨屋》让人穿过雨却不被淋湿。
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 柏林，德国

creators.name: Tracy Fullerton
creators.role: Professor and director of the USC Game Innovation Lab
creators.bio: Game designer and educator who makes experimental games.
creators.why: Walden, a game rewards attention to nature rather than conquest.
creators.role_zh: 南加州大学游戏创新实验室主任、教授
creators.bio_zh: 制作实验性游戏的游戏设计师与教育者。
creators.why_zh: 《瓦尔登湖》这款游戏奖励对自然的关注，而不是征服。

creators.name: Ed Key & David Kanaga
creators.role: Game designer and composer
creators.bio: Makers of Proteus, an island exploration game without goals.
creators.why: Proteus makes wandering and listening the whole game.
creators.role_zh: 游戏设计师与作曲家
creators.bio_zh: 《Proteus》的创作者，这是一款没有目标的岛屿探索游戏。
creators.why_zh: 《Proteus》把漫游和聆听当作游戏的全部。

creators.name: thatgamecompany
creators.role: Game studio co-founded by Jenova Chen
creators.bio: Studio behind flOw, Flower, Journey and Sky.
creators.why: Flower plays as the wind carrying petals, contrasting city and field.
creators.role_zh: 由陈星汉共同创立的游戏工作室
creators.bio_zh: 《flOw》《Flower》《Journey》《Sky》的开发工作室。
creators.why_zh: 《Flower》让玩家扮演携带花瓣的风，对比城市与田野。

creators.name: Strange Loop Games
creators.role: Game studio
creators.bio: Studio behind Eco, a multiplayer ecosystem-and-economy simulation.
creators.why: In Eco, a shared simulated ecosystem can collapse because of players' choices.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室
creators.bio_zh: 开发多人生态与经济模拟游戏《Eco》的工作室。
creators.why_zh: 在《Eco》中，共享的模拟生态会因为玩家的选择而崩溃。

creators.name: ustwo games
creators.role: Game studio
creators.bio: London studio known for Monument Valley and Alba.
creators.why: Alba pairs birdwatching play with a real-world tree-planting pledge.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室
creators.bio_zh: 以《纪念碑谷》和《Alba》闻名的伦敦工作室。
creators.why_zh: 《Alba》把观鸟玩法与现实中的植树承诺结合在一起。

creators.name: Free Lives
creators.role: Game studio
creators.bio: South African studio behind Broforce and Terra Nil.
creators.why: Terra Nil reverses the city builder: you restore land and then remove your own buildings.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室
creators.bio_zh: 开发《Broforce》和《Terra Nil》的南非工作室。
creators.why_zh: 《Terra Nil》颠倒了城市建造类游戏：你修复土地，然后拆掉自己的建筑。

creators.name: E-Line Media
creators.role: Game publisher and developer
creators.bio: Studio behind Never Alone and Beyond Blue.
creators.why: Beyond Blue builds an ocean game from real science and BBC Blue Planet II footage.
creators.role_zh: 游戏发行与开发商
creators.bio_zh: 开发《Never Alone》与《Beyond Blue》的工作室。
creators.why_zh: 《Beyond Blue》以真实科学和 BBC《蓝色星球 II》素材打造海洋游戏。

creators.name: Greener Games
creators.role: Independent studio (John Carline)
creators.bio: Small studio that makes relaxing VR nature environments.
creators.why: Nature Treks VR is widely used as a virtual nature dose in wellbeing and hospital settings.
creators.role_zh: 独立工作室（John Carline）
creators.bio_zh: 制作放松型 VR 自然环境的小型工作室。
creators.why_zh: 《Nature Treks VR》在健康与医院场景中被广泛用作“虚拟自然剂量”。

creators.name: Wevr
creators.role: VR studio
creators.bio: Los Angeles company known for theBlu VR series.
creators.why: theBlu: Whale Encounter was many people's first VR experience.
creators.role_zh: VR 工作室
creators.bio_zh: 以 VR 系列《theBlu》闻名的洛杉矶公司。
creators.why_zh: 《theBlu：与鲸相遇》是许多人的第一次 VR 体验。

creators.name: Matthew H. E. M. Browning
creators.role: Associate Professor, Department of Parks, Recreation and Tourism Management, Clemson University; director of the Virtual Reality & Nature Lab
creators.bio: Environmental health researcher who tests virtual nature against real nature.
creators.why: His experiments show where simulated nature helps and where it falls short.
creators.role_zh: 克莱姆森大学公园、休闲与旅游管理系副教授，Virtual Reality & Nature Lab 主任
creators.bio_zh: 环境健康研究者，比较虚拟自然与真实自然的效果。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验显示了模拟自然在哪些方面有效、在哪些方面不足。

creators.name: Gardens by the Bay
creators.role: National garden (masterplan by Grant Associates, conservatories by Wilkinson Eyre)
creators.bio: Singapore's 101-hectare garden park with artificial Supertrees and cooled conservatories.
creators.why: It is a flagship of engineered, technological nature in a city.
creators.role_zh: 国家公园（总体规划 Grant Associates，温室 Wilkinson Eyre）
creators.bio_zh: 新加坡占地 101 公顷的花园公园，拥有人造“超级树”和降温温室。
creators.why_zh: 它是城市中“工程化、技术化自然”的旗舰案例。

creators.name: Biosphere 2
creators.role: Earth system science facility, University of Arizona (built by Space Biospheres Ventures)
creators.bio: Sealed glass building containing a rainforest, ocean, desert and farm.
creators.why: It remains the largest attempt to build an entire nature inside technology.
creators.role_zh: 亚利桑那大学地球系统科学设施（由 Space Biospheres Ventures 建造）
creators.bio_zh: 一座封闭的玻璃建筑，内含雨林、海洋、沙漠与农田。
creators.why_zh: 它至今仍是在技术之内建造一整个自然的最大尝试。

creators.name: Haru Ji & Graham Wakefield
creators.role: Artists; Graham Wakefield is Associate Professor at York University (Alice Lab)
creators.bio: Artist duo who build immersive artificial ecosystems as their long-running series Artificial Nature.
creators.why: Their worlds evolve with and without visitors, making digital nature alive rather than decorative.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；Graham Wakefield 为约克大学副教授（Alice Lab）
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家二人组，以长期系列《Artificial Nature》构建沉浸式人工生态系统。
creators.why_zh: 他们的世界在有无观众时都在演化，让数字自然是活的，而非装饰。

creators.name: Jon McCormack
creators.role: Professor and director of SensiLab, Monash University
creators.bio: Artist and researcher in generative art and artificial life.
creators.why: Eden is an evolving sonic ecosystem that adapts to how people move around it.
creators.role_zh: 莫纳什大学教授，SensiLab 主任
creators.bio_zh: 生成艺术与人工生命领域的艺术家与研究者。
creators.why_zh: 《Eden》是一个会根据观众走动而演化的声音生态系统。

creators.name: Joan Sol Roo
creators.role: HCI researcher (PhD, Inria Bordeaux, Potioc team)
creators.bio: Researcher on spatial augmented reality and mindfulness.
creators.why: Inner Garden turns breathing and heart rate into a living miniature landscape.
creators.role_zh: HCI 研究者（Inria 波尔多 Potioc 团队博士）
creators.bio_zh: 研究空间增强现实与正念。
creators.why_zh: 《Inner Garden》把呼吸与心率变成一个活的微缩景观。

creators.name: Lynette Wallworth
creators.role: Artist and filmmaker
creators.bio: Australian artist who makes immersive works with communities, including Collisions and Awavena.
creators.why: Awavena shows the forest through the vision of a Yawanawá shaman.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与电影人
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家，与社区合作创作《Collisions》《Awavena》等沉浸式作品。
creators.why_zh: 《Awavena》通过一位 Yawanawá 萨满的视野呈现森林。

creators.name: Studio Drift
creators.role: Artist duo Lonneke Gordijn and Ralph Nauta
creators.bio: Dutch studio making kinetic sculptures inspired by natural behaviour.
creators.why: Its works rebuild natural phenomena, from dandelions to flocks, with technology.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组 Lonneke Gordijn 与 Ralph Nauta
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰工作室，以自然行为为灵感创作动态雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 它用技术重建自然现象，从蒲公英到鸟群。

creators.name: Theo Jansen
creators.role: Artist
creators.bio: Dutch artist who has built wind-walking 'beach animals' from PVC tubing since 1990.
creators.why: His Strandbeests are a technological species evolving to live on the beach.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家，自 1990 年起用 PVC 管制作靠风行走的“海滩生物”。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Strandbeest 是一种为在海滩生存而演化的技术物种。

works.title: Technological Nature: Adaptation and the Future of Human Life
works.description: A book that reports a decade of studies on robot dogs, nature webcams and plasma-screen 'windows', and asks what people lose when technological nature replaces real nature.
works.description_zh: 这本书汇集了作者十年间关于机器狗、自然直播和等离子屏“窗户”的研究，追问当技术化的自然取代真实自然时，人会失去什么。
works.idea_en: Technological nature is better than no nature, but not as good as actual nature, and people may not notice the difference.
works.idea_zh: 技术化的自然好过没有自然，却不如真实的自然，而人们可能察觉不到其中的差别。
works.method: Synthesises controlled experiments, field studies and interviews from the HINTS Lab with developmental psychology and the idea of environmental generational amnesia.
works.method_zh: 综合 HINTS 实验室的对照实验、田野研究与访谈，结合发展心理学以及“环境代际失忆”的概念。

paper.title: Technological Nature: Adaptation and the Future of Human Life

works.title: The Human Relation With Nature and Technological Nature
works.description: A short review that defines technological nature (technologies that mediate, augment or simulate nature) and summarises evidence that it offers some but not all benefits of real nature.
works.description_zh: 一篇简短综述，定义了“技术化的自然”（媒介、增强或模拟自然的技术），并总结证据：它只能提供真实自然的部分益处。
works.idea_en: Ask of every nature technology: is it a supplement or a substitute?
works.idea_zh: 对每一种自然类技术都要问：它是补充，还是替代？
works.method: Reviews the authors' experiments with real windows, plasma displays, robotic pets and webcams and draws a research agenda from them.
works.method_zh: 回顾作者关于真实窗户、等离子屏、机器宠物和网络摄像头的实验，并据此提出研究议程。

paper.title: The Human Relation With Nature and Technological Nature

works.title: Extinction of Experience: The Loss of Human–Nature Interactions
works.description: A review showing that people everywhere are having fewer direct experiences of nature, and that this loss harms health and weakens support for conservation.
works.description_zh: 这篇综述指出，世界各地的人与自然的直接接触都在减少，这既损害健康，也削弱人们对自然保护的支持。
works.idea_en: Less contact with nature leads to less care for it, which leads to less nature: a loop design can try to break.
works.idea_zh: 越少接触自然，就越不在乎它，自然也就越少，这是设计可以尝试打破的循环。
works.method: Synthesises ecological and psychological studies into a model of causes (opportunity, orientation) and consequences of lost human–nature interaction.
works.method_zh: 综合生态学与心理学研究，建立关于人与自然交互减少的成因（机会与意愿）及后果的模型。

paper.venue: Frontiers in Ecology and the Environment 2016
paper.title: Extinction of experience: the loss of human–nature interactions

works.title: View Through a Window May Influence Recovery from Surgery
works.description: A hospital study in which gallbladder surgery patients whose window faced trees had shorter stays and needed fewer strong painkillers than patients facing a brick wall.
works.description_zh: 一项医院研究：胆囊手术后，窗外是树的病人比窗外是砖墙的病人住院更短、所需强效止痛药更少。
works.idea_en: Even a view of nature through glass is measurably good for the body.
works.idea_zh: 哪怕隔着玻璃看到自然，也能对身体产生可测量的好处。
works.method: Compared matched pairs of patient records from 1972–1981 in a Pennsylvania hospital, differing only in the view from the room.
works.method_zh: 比较宾夕法尼亚一家医院 1972–1981 年间病历中配对的病人，他们的差别只在病房窗景。

paper.title: View Through a Window May Influence Recovery from Surgery

works.title: The Experience of Nature: A Psychological Perspective
works.description: A book that sets out Attention Restoration Theory: natural settings capture 'soft fascination' and let tired directed attention recover.
works.description_zh: 这本书提出了注意力恢复理论：自然环境引发“柔和的吸引”，让疲惫的定向注意力得以恢复。
works.idea_en: Design restorative experiences around soft fascination, being away, extent and compatibility.
works.idea_zh: 围绕柔和的吸引、远离感、延展性与契合度来设计恢复性体验。
works.method: Draws on two decades of landscape preference studies and wilderness programme research.
works.method_zh: 基于二十年的景观偏好研究和荒野项目研究。

works.title: Biophilia
works.description: A book of essays proposing that humans have an innate tendency to focus on life and lifelike processes.
works.description_zh: 一本随笔集，提出人天生倾向于关注生命与类生命的过程。
works.idea_en: Our attraction to living things is part of human nature, so designs can build on it.
works.idea_zh: 被生命吸引是人性的一部分，设计可以以此为基础。
works.method: Combines evolutionary biology with the author's field experience in the tropics.
works.method_zh: 结合进化生物学与作者在热带地区的野外经历。

works.title: Biophilic Design: The Theory, Science and Practice of Bringing Buildings to Life
works.description: An edited volume, with Judith Heerwagen and Martin Mador, that translates biophilia into about 70 attributes for designing buildings and places.
works.description_zh: 与 Judith Heerwagen、Martin Mador 合编的文集，把亲生命性转化为约 70 项建筑与场所设计属性。
works.idea_en: Nature in design is more than plants: light, materials, shapes, prospect and refuge all count.
works.idea_zh: 设计中的自然不止是植物：光线、材料、形态、眺望与庇护都算在内。
works.method: Collects contributions from architects, psychologists and biologists and organises them into direct, indirect and spatial experiences of nature.
works.method_zh: 汇集建筑师、心理学家和生物学家的文章，把自然体验分为直接、间接和空间三类。

works.title: Last Child in the Woods
works.description: A book that describes how children's unstructured time outdoors has shrunk and names the result 'nature-deficit disorder'.
works.description_zh: 这本书描述了儿童在户外自由活动的时间如何缩减，并把后果称为“自然缺失症”。
works.idea_en: Children's distance from nature is a design and policy problem, not only a personal choice.
works.idea_zh: 儿童与自然的疏离是设计和政策问题，不只是个人选择。
works.method: Combines interviews with parents, teachers and researchers with a review of studies on nature and child development.
works.method_zh: 结合对家长、教师和研究者的访谈，以及自然与儿童发展研究的综述。

works.title: The Connectedness to Nature Scale
works.description: A 14-item questionnaire, developed with Cynthia McPherson Frantz, that measures how much a person feels part of the natural world.
works.description_zh: 与 Cynthia McPherson Frantz 共同开发的 14 题问卷，测量一个人感到自己属于自然世界的程度。
works.idea_en: If you design for nature connection, measure it.
works.idea_zh: 如果为自然联结而设计，就去测量它。
works.method: Validated across five studies linking scale scores to ecological behaviour and wellbeing.
works.method_zh: 通过五项研究验证，把量表得分与生态行为及幸福感联系起来。

paper.title: The connectedness to nature scale: A measure of individuals' feeling in community with nature

works.title: Beyond Knowing Nature: Pathways to Nature Connection
works.description: A study, with Ryan Lumber and David Sheffield, showing that contact, emotion, compassion, meaning and beauty build nature connection, while knowledge-based activities such as identifying species do not.
works.description_zh: 与 Ryan Lumber、David Sheffield 合作的研究表明：感官接触、情感、同情、意义与美能建立自然联结，而识别物种这类知识型活动则不能。
works.idea_en: Knowing the names of species is not the same as feeling connected; design for feeling.
works.idea_zh: 知道物种的名字不等于感到联结，要为感受而设计。
works.method: Two online surveys (n = 321) built around the nine values of the biophilia hypothesis, then a walking intervention (n = 72) that put the identified pathways into practice.
works.method_zh: 两项在线调查（n = 321）围绕亲生命性假说的九种价值展开，随后以步行干预（n = 72）实践所识别出的路径。

paper.title: Beyond knowing nature: Contact, emotion, compassion, meaning, and beauty are pathways to nature connection

works.title: HCI Outdoors: Theory, Design, Methods and Applications
works.description: An edited book (Jones, Anderson, Häkkilä, Cheverst, Daiber) that maps interaction design for hiking, climbing, skiing, camping and wild places, following a CHI 2018 workshop.
works.description_zh: 一本编著（Jones、Anderson、Häkkilä、Cheverst、Daiber），源于 CHI 2018 工作坊，梳理了面向徒步、攀岩、滑雪、露营和野外场所的交互设计。
works.idea_en: The outdoors is its own design context, with values such as solitude, risk and disconnection.
works.idea_zh: 户外是一个独立的设计情境，有其自身的价值：独处、风险与断联。
works.method: Collects chapters on theory, methods for research in the wild and case studies of outdoor systems.
works.method_zh: 收录理论、野外研究方法与户外系统案例等章节。

paper.title: HCI Outdoors: Theory, Design, Methods and Applications

works.title: Citizen Science: New Research Challenges for Human–Computer Interaction
works.description: A paper that sets out what HCI can contribute to biodiversity citizen science: motivation, data quality, usability and long-term participation.
works.description_zh: 一篇论文，阐述 HCI 能为生物多样性公民科学贡献什么：动机、数据质量、可用性与长期参与。
works.idea_en: Citizen science tools succeed or fail on interaction design, not only on the science.
works.idea_zh: 公民科学工具的成败取决于交互设计，而不只是科学本身。
works.method: Reviews projects such as iNaturalist, eBird and NatureNet and draws open research questions from them.
works.method_zh: 回顾 iNaturalist、eBird、NatureNet 等项目，并提炼开放的研究问题。

paper.title: Citizen Science: New Research Challenges for Human–Computer Interaction

works.title: From Conservation to Crowdsourcing: A Typology of Citizen Science
works.description: A paper, with Kevin Crowston, that sorts citizen science projects into five types: action, conservation, investigation, virtual and education.
works.description_zh: 与 Kevin Crowston 合写的论文，把公民科学项目分为五类：行动、保护、调查、虚拟与教育。
works.idea_en: Different kinds of citizen science need different technology and different roles for volunteers.
works.idea_zh: 不同类型的公民科学需要不同的技术，以及志愿者的不同角色。
works.method: Clusters survey data from 80 projects by goals, organisation and technology use.
works.method_zh: 根据目标、组织方式和技术使用，对 80 个项目的调查数据进行聚类。

paper.title: From Conservation to Crowdsourcing: A Typology of Citizen Science

works.title: Citizen Science: A Developing Tool for Expanding Science Knowledge and Scientific Literacy
works.description: A paper describing the Cornell Lab of Ornithology's model for citizen science projects, from choosing a question to analysing volunteer data.
works.description_zh: 一篇论文，介绍康奈尔鸟类学实验室的公民科学项目模式：从确定问题到分析志愿者数据。
works.idea_en: Treat volunteers as research partners, and design the whole pipeline around them.
works.idea_zh: 把志愿者当作研究伙伴，并围绕他们设计整个流程。
works.method: Draws on two decades of bird projects such as Project FeederWatch and eBird.
works.method_zh: 基于 Project FeederWatch、eBird 等二十年来的鸟类项目经验。

paper.title: Citizen Science: A Developing Tool for Expanding Science Knowledge and Scientific Literacy

works.title: Soundscape Ecology
works.description: A special issue introduction, with Almo Farina, that defines soundscape ecology as the study of all the sounds of a landscape: animal sounds, geophysical sounds and human noise.
works.description_zh: 与 Almo Farina 合写的专刊导言，把声景生态学定义为研究一个景观中全部声音的学科：动物声、地球物理声与人类噪声。
works.idea_en: Listening to a place is a way of measuring its health.
works.idea_zh: 聆听一个地方，就是测量它的健康。
works.method: Frames concepts such as biophony, geophony and anthrophony and methods for long-term acoustic monitoring.
works.method_zh: 提出生物声、地声与人为声等概念，以及长期声学监测的方法。

paper.title: Introduction to the special issue on soundscape ecology

works.title: Seeding a Repository of Methods-To-Be for Nature-Entangled Design Research
works.description: A DIS paper sharing an annotated portfolio of emerging, not-yet-polished methods for nature-entangled design, gathered and tried during a conference workshop.
works.description_zh: 一篇 DIS 论文，以注释作品集的形式分享一批仍在形成中的“与自然纠缠的设计”方法，这些方法在一次会议工作坊中被收集和试用。
works.idea_en: Designing with nature needs its own methods, and they should be shared and tried.
works.idea_zh: 与自然共同设计需要专属的方法，这些方法应当被分享和试用。
works.method: Workshop-based collection, cross-pollination of methods in use, and discussion of how to articulate them further.
works.method_zh: 基于工作坊收集方法，在使用中交叉融合，并讨论如何进一步表述它们。

paper.title: Seeding a Repository of Methods-To-Be for Nature-Entangled Design Research

works.title: Digital Nature
works.description: A concept and research programme, laid out in talks and in the 2018 book 'Digital Nature', that describes a future where computers and nature merge into one environment.
works.description_zh: 一个概念与研究纲领，在演讲和 2018 年的著作《デジタルネイチャー》中提出，描述计算机与自然融合为同一环境的未来。
works.idea_en: Stop treating the digital as the opposite of nature; treat it as the next layer of nature.
works.idea_zh: 不要把数字当作自然的对立面，而要把它看作自然的新一层。
works.method: Builds the argument through the Digital Nature Group's works in acoustic levitation, holography and computational fabrication.
works.method_zh: 通过 Digital Nature Group 在声悬浮、全息和计算制造方面的作品来构建论点。

works.title: The Design of Eco-Feedback Technology
works.description: A CHI paper, with Leah Findlater and James Landay, that surveys eco-feedback technology and bridges HCI and environmental psychology.
works.description_zh: 与 Leah Findlater、James Landay 合写的 CHI 论文，综述生态反馈技术，并连接 HCI 与环境心理学。
works.idea_en: Showing people their environmental impact only works if the display fits how behaviour actually changes.
works.idea_zh: 向人展示其环境影响，只有在展示方式符合行为改变的规律时才有效。
works.method: Reviews 89 environmental psychology studies and HCI eco-feedback systems and derives design dimensions.
works.method_zh: 综述 89 项环境心理学研究与 HCI 生态反馈系统，提炼设计维度。

paper.title: The design of eco-feedback technology

works.title: Phenology Circles: A Method to Deepen Relations in More-Than-Human Design Processes
works.description: A DIS paper by Shannon Rodgers and colleagues describing a 'phenology circle': an online, global gardening community the researchers ran for over two years to attune to the rhythms of plants, animals and one another.
works.description_zh: Shannon Rodgers 等人的 DIS 论文，介绍“物候圈”：研究者运营两年多的一个线上全球园艺社群，用来调谐于植物、动物以及彼此的节律。
works.idea_en: A shared practice of noticing the seasons deepens designers' relations with other species around the design work.
works.idea_zh: 一起留意季节变化的共同实践，能在设计工作周围加深设计者与其他物种的关系。
works.method: Online community of practice (N = 42) sharing over 1,200 images and posts; reflection on eight core members in the backstage of participatory design research.
works.method_zh: 线上实践社群（N = 42）分享了 1200 多条图片与帖子；在参与式设计研究的幕后，对八位核心成员的活动进行反思。

paper.title: Phenology Circles: A Method to Deepen Relations in More-Than-Human Design Processes

works.title: The Ambient Birdhouse
works.description: An IoT birdhouse for the home that plays local bird calls and media to spark curiosity about the birds outside; it was trialled with five families.
works.description_zh: 一个家用的物联网鸟屋，播放本地鸟类的叫声与相关媒体，激发人们对窗外鸟类的好奇；研究者与五个家庭一起进行了试用。
works.idea_en: A small ambient object can introduce neighbours of other species.
works.idea_zh: 一个小小的环境物件，就能介绍其他物种的邻居。
works.method: Playful tangible IoT device using recordings of local species, studied in family homes, where children drew the rest of the family in.
works.method_zh: 使用本地物种录音的趣味实体物联网设备，在家庭中进行研究，孩子们带动了家中其他成员。

paper.title: The Ambient Birdhouse: An IoT Device to Discover Birds and Engage with Nature

works.title: Nature Jar
works.description: A home prototype, designed after a cultural probes study, that encourages city dwellers to notice, value and spend more time with the nature near where they live, and brings nature's restorative effects indoors.
works.description_zh: 一个在文化探针研究之后设计的家用原型，鼓励城市居民留意、珍视并更多接触住处附近的自然，并把自然的恢复作用带进室内。
works.idea_en: Link the home to the nature just outside it, gently, through an everyday object.
works.idea_zh: 通过一件日常物品，温和地把家与门外的自然连接起来。
works.method: Cultural probes with urban residents, followed by a tangible prototype that likely links indoor life with nearby nature.
works.method_zh: 先对城市居民进行文化探针研究，再制作一个很可能把室内生活与附近自然相连的实体原型。

paper.title: Nature Jar: Design for Facilitating Nature Connectedness and Restoration in Home Scenario

works.title: From-The-Wild: Towards Co-Designing For and From Nature
works.description: A CHI late-breaking work that proposes co-designing technology outdoors, letting nature itself shape the design session.
works.description_zh: 一篇 CHI 短论文，提出在户外共同设计技术，让自然本身参与塑造设计过程。
works.idea_en: Take the design workshop to the forest and let the forest talk back.
works.idea_zh: 把设计工作坊搬进森林，让森林回应。
works.method: Runs participatory design activities in natural settings and reflects on how place changes the ideas produced.
works.method_zh: 在自然环境中开展参与式设计活动，反思场所如何改变产生的想法。

paper.title: From-The-Wild: Towards Co-Designing For and From Nature

works.title: Playful Inspiration for a New Wave of Joyful Forest Technology
works.description: A DIS paper that explores the playful potential of forests and how technology could respond to it, arguing for forest tech built on joy and care rather than techno-solutionism.
works.description_zh: 一篇 DIS 论文，探索森林中蕴含的游戏潜能以及技术如何回应它，主张以快乐与照料而非技术解决主义来做森林技术。
works.idea_en: Forest tech should help people enjoy the forest, not only learn facts about it.
works.idea_zh: 森林技术应帮助人享受森林，而不只是了解关于它的知识。
works.method: First-person, speculative and situated design on 16 trips to the forest, yielding 13 play potentials grouped into 5 design directions.
works.method_zh: 通过 16 次进入森林的第一人称、思辨与情境化设计，得出 13 种游戏潜能，归为 5 个设计方向。

paper.title: Playful Inspiration for a New Wave of Joyful Forest Technology

works.title: Wild Probes Toolkit
works.description: A set of probing tools that moves co-design into the forest, helping forest-goers pay attention to, reflect on, ideate around and document their forest experiences.
works.description_zh: 一套把共同设计搬进森林的探针工具，帮助林中行者去关注、反思、构思并记录自己的森林体验。
works.idea_en: Give co-designers tools to attend to a place before they imagine technology for it.
works.idea_zh: 在想象技术之前，先给共同设计者工具，让他们去关注这个地方。
works.method: Toolkit designed for forestry future-making and used in early outdoor co-design sessions; open for other designers to extend.
works.method_zh: 为“森林未来构想”而设计，并在早期户外共同设计中使用，开放给其他设计者扩展。

paper.title: Designing and Using the Wild Probes Toolkit (v1) to Co-Design From-the-Wild

works.title: How Can Interactive Technology Help Us to Experience Joy With(in) the Forest?
works.description: A CHI paper presenting a taxonomy of 12 ways interactive technology might support joyful forest experiences.
works.description_zh: 一篇 CHI 论文，提出一套包含 12 种方式的分类，说明交互技术可以如何支持人在森林中的快乐体验。
works.idea_en: Joy is a design goal in its own right for nature technology.
works.idea_zh: 对自然类技术而言，快乐本身就是一个设计目标。
works.method: Reflexive analysis of 104 speculative ideas from a year-long co-design process with more than 250 forest-goers.
works.method_zh: 对一年期共同设计过程中与 250 多位林中行者产生的 104 个思辨想法进行反身性分析。

paper.title: How Can Interactive Technology Help Us to Experience Joy With(in) the Forest? Towards a Taxonomy of Tech for Joyful Human-Forest Interactions

works.title: Dear Nature: Data Drawings for Human–Nature Relations
works.description: A DIS paper, with Sherry Hsi, in which participants in different places turned their own observations of nature into hand-drawn data drawings over five weeks and compared them.
works.description_zh: 与 Sherry Hsi 合作的 DIS 论文：身处不同地方的参与者在五周内把自己对自然的观察画成手绘数据图，并相互比较。
works.idea_en: Drawing personal data about nature by hand slows people down and deepens reflection.
works.idea_zh: 亲手绘制关于自然的个人数据，会让人放慢并加深反思。
works.method: Post-humanist design method based on data humanism and cooperative inquiry across geographies.
works.method_zh: 基于数据人文主义与跨地域合作探究的后人类主义设计方法。

paper.title: Dear Nature: Using data drawings to promote sensemaking in human-nature relations

works.title: The Entangled Tales that Landscapes Tell
works.description: A TEI paper that studies how nature walks are experienced through the body and imagination, and turns this into a teaching method for designing locative technologies for natural heritage.
works.description_zh: 一篇 TEI 论文，研究人如何通过身体与想象体验自然漫步，并把它转化为一种为自然遗产设计位置技术的教学方法。
works.idea_en: Walking and storytelling can be an HCI method for relating to a landscape.
works.idea_zh: 行走与讲故事可以是一种与风景建立关系的 HCI 方法。
works.method: Study of the lived and sensory experience of nature walks, leading to an organic pedagogy and design implications for locative tools.
works.method_zh: 研究自然漫步的亲身与感官体验，进而提出一种“有机”教学法以及位置类工具的设计启示。

paper.title: The Entangled Tales that Landscapes Tell: An Embodied HCI Pedagogy for Re-enchanted Nature Walks

works.title: Forest
works.description: A focus app in which a virtual tree grows while you leave your phone alone and dies if you open another app; coins can fund real trees planted by the partner Trees for the Future.
works.description_zh: 一款专注应用：你不碰手机时虚拟树会生长，打开其他应用树就会枯死；积攒的金币可以资助合作伙伴 Trees for the Future 种下真实的树。
works.idea_en: Use a growing tree as a metaphor for attention, and link it to real trees.
works.idea_zh: 把一棵生长的树作为注意力的隐喻，并把它与真实的树连接起来。
works.method: Timer-based mobile app with a virtual forest record and a donation link to tree planting.
works.method_zh: 基于计时器的手机应用，带有虚拟森林记录，并连接植树捐赠。

works.title: Future Library
works.description: A 100-year artwork in Oslo: 1,000 trees were planted in Nordmarka forest in 2014, one writer a year contributes an unread manuscript, and in 2114 the trees will be cut to print the books.
works.description_zh: 一件在奥斯陆展开的百年作品：2014 年在 Nordmarka 森林种下 1000 棵树，每年一位作家贡献一部不公开的手稿，2114 年砍伐这些树来印刷这些书。
works.idea_en: Tie a cultural promise to the growth of a forest to think in tree time.
works.idea_zh: 把一个文化承诺与森林的生长绑在一起，用树的时间来思考。
works.method: Planted forest, a sealed archive room in the Deichman library, and yearly handover ceremonies in the forest.
works.method_zh: 种植的森林、Deichman 图书馆中的封存阅览室，以及每年在林中举行的交稿仪式。

works.title: Kits Beach Soundwalk
works.description: A soundscape composition in which the composer walks the listener along a Vancouver beach, filtering out city noise to reveal the tiny sounds of barnacles.
works.description_zh: 一部声景作品：作曲家带着听者沿温哥华的海滩行走，滤掉城市噪声，让藤壶细微的声响浮现出来。
works.idea_en: Selective listening can turn a noisy place back into a living one.
works.idea_zh: 有选择的聆听，能让嘈杂之地重新显露生机。
works.method: Field recording with spoken narration and studio filtering and equalisation.
works.method_zh: 现场录音配以口述旁白，并在录音室中进行滤波与均衡处理。

works.title: explore.org Live Nature Cams
works.description: A network of free live cameras, including Katmai's Brooks Falls bears and the Decorah eagle nest, watched by millions who follow individual animals through a season.
works.description_zh: 一个免费的实时镜头网络，包括卡特迈国家公园布鲁克斯瀑布的熊和 Decorah 鹰巢，数百万人借此追踪个体动物的一整个季节。
works.idea_en: Live, unedited nature can build attachment to individual wild animals at a distance.
works.idea_zh: 实时、不剪辑的自然，能让人远距离地对个体野生动物产生依恋。
works.method: Solar-powered cameras streaming to YouTube and explore.org, with chat communities and events such as Fat Bear Week.
works.method_zh: 太阳能摄像头向 YouTube 和 explore.org 直播，配合聊天社群与“胖熊周”等活动。

works.title: Songs of the Humpback Whale
works.description: An album of hydrophone recordings of humpback whale songs that sold over 100,000 copies and fuelled the 'Save the Whales' movement.
works.description_zh: 一张用水听器录制的座头鲸歌声专辑，销量超过 10 万张，推动了“拯救鲸鱼”运动。
works.idea_en: Hearing another species' song can change a whole society's relation to it.
works.idea_zh: 听见另一个物种的歌声，可以改变整个社会与它的关系。
works.method: US Navy and field hydrophone recordings off Bermuda, released by CRM Records after Payne and McVay's analysis of song structure.
works.method_zh: 在百慕大海域用美国海军和野外水听器录制，Payne 与 McVay 分析歌曲结构后由 CRM Records 发行。

works.title: Ambient Wood
works.description: An augmented woodland in Sussex where pairs of children explored with probes and PDAs that played sounds and showed hidden processes such as photosynthesis when they reached certain plants.
works.description_zh: 苏塞克斯的一片被增强的树林：孩子们两人一组带着探测器和 PDA 探索，走到特定植物旁时，设备会播放声音、显示光合作用等看不见的过程。
works.idea_en: Augment a real wood with hidden layers rather than replacing it with a screen.
works.idea_zh: 给真实的树林叠加隐藏的层次，而不是用屏幕取代它。
works.method: Ubiquitous computing kit (PDAs, light and moisture probes, location-triggered audio) deployed with learning scientists from the Equator project.
works.method_zh: 由 Equator 项目的学习科学研究者部署的普适计算套件（PDA、光照与湿度探针、位置触发音频）。

paper.title: Ambient wood: designing new forms of digital augmentation for learning outdoors

works.title: Savannah
works.description: A location-based game in which children, carrying handheld computers on a school field, played a pride of lions hunting and surviving on a virtual African savannah.
works.description_zh: 一个基于位置的游戏：孩子们带着掌上电脑在学校操场上扮演狮群，在虚拟的非洲草原上捕猎与生存。
works.idea_en: Let children learn animal behaviour by moving through space as the animal.
works.idea_zh: 让孩子以动物的身份在空间中移动，从而学习动物行为。
works.method: GPS-enabled PDAs map a virtual savannah onto a playing field; a 'den' debrief area supports reflection; built by Futurelab with HP Labs and studied with ten children aged 11–12.
works.method_zh: 带 GPS 的 PDA 把虚拟草原映射到操场上，“兽穴”区域用于复盘；由 Futurelab 与惠普实验室合作开发，并与十名 11–12 岁儿童一起研究。

paper.title: Savannah: mobile gaming and learning?

works.title: Environmental Detectives
works.description: An augmented reality game in which students roam a real campus or watershed with handhelds, taking simulated water samples to find the source of a toxic spill.
works.description_zh: 一款增强现实游戏：学生带着掌上设备在真实的校园或流域中走动，采集模拟水样，找出有毒泄漏的来源。
works.idea_en: Put an environmental simulation on top of real terrain so investigation involves walking.
works.idea_zh: 把环境模拟叠加在真实地形上，让调查必须靠行走完成。
works.method: GPS-located PDAs running a groundwater contamination model; later versions ran on the MIT AR platform.
works.method_zh: 运行地下水污染模型、带 GPS 定位的 PDA；后续版本基于 MIT AR 平台。

paper.title: Environmental Detectives—the development of an augmented reality platform for environmental simulations

works.title: HOBBIT: An Asocial Hiking App
works.description: A hiking app, by Maaret Posti, Johannes Schöning and Jonna Häkkilä, that generates routes avoiding other people and warns when hikers approach, so users can enjoy solitude in nature.
works.description_zh: Maaret Posti、Johannes Schöning 与 Jonna Häkkilä 设计的徒步应用，生成避开人群的路线，并在有人接近时提醒，让用户享受自然中的独处。
works.idea_en: Design for being alone in nature: an asocial app.
works.idea_zh: 为在自然中独处而设计：一个“反社交”应用。
works.method: Route generator using OpenStreetMap and web data, plus a mobile prototype that scans Wi-Fi signals to detect nearby hikers; concept based on a survey (n = 157) and focus groups.
works.method_zh: 利用 OpenStreetMap 与网络数据生成路线，另有一个扫描 Wi-Fi 信号以探测附近徒步者的手机原型；概念来自问卷（n = 157）与焦点小组。

paper.title: Unexpected journeys with the HOBBIT: the design and evaluation of an asocial hiking app

works.title: Capra
works.description: A system that captures hikes from several perspectives (camera, sound, movement, altitude) and lets hikers revisit and compare them at home over years.
works.description_zh: 一个从多个视角（影像、声音、运动、海拔）记录徒步的系统，让徒步者多年后在家中重温和比较这些路程。
works.idea_en: Design for revisiting nature experiences slowly, long after they happen.
works.idea_zh: 为在事后很久、慢慢重温自然体验而设计。
works.method: Custom capture device, archive and home exploration interface, designed, built and lived with by the design team over four years.
works.method_zh: 定制的采集设备、数据档案与家用浏览界面，由设计团队在四年间设计、制作并亲身使用。

paper.title: Capra: Making Use of Multiple Perspectives for Capturing, Noticing and Revisiting Hiking Experiences Over Time

works.title: Designing Children's Digital-Physical Play in Natural Outdoors Settings
works.description: A CHI paper in which interaction designers and landscape architects installed interactive play technology as part of a schoolyard and observed how it mixed with play with natural materials.
works.description_zh: 一篇 CHI 论文：交互设计师与景观建筑师把交互游戏技术作为校园环境的一部分安装起来，观察它如何与利用自然材料的游戏交织。
works.idea_en: In nature play, technology should be a light spice, not the main dish.
works.idea_zh: 在自然游戏中，技术应当是点缀，而不是主菜。
works.method: Schoolyard field trial of play technology integrated into a natural outdoor setting.
works.method_zh: 在自然化户外环境中整合游戏技术的校园实地试验。

paper.title: Designing Children's Digital-Physical Play in Natural Outdoors Settings

works.title: Daddy, You Can Be the Fox
works.description: A permanent playground installation: a small play hut in the landscape with interactive audio stories about local wildlife, developed and evaluated over six years.
works.description_zh: 一个永久性游乐场装置：融入景观的小游戏屋，配有关于本地野生动物的交互式音频故事，历时六年开发与评估。
works.idea_en: Playgrounds can tell stories that point children toward the nature around them.
works.idea_zh: 游乐场可以讲故事，把孩子的目光引向身边的自然。
works.method: Research through design with a multisectorial team; children re-used the stories in their own play.
works.method_zh: 跨部门团队的通过设计进行研究，孩子们把故事融入了自己的游戏中。

paper.title: Daddy, You Can Be the Fox: Designing Hybrid Playgrounds for Nature Integrated Storytelling

works.title: Geocaching
works.description: A worldwide treasure hunt in which players use GPS coordinates to find millions of hidden containers, many placed in parks, forests and other natural sites.
works.description_zh: 一种全球寻宝游戏：玩家用 GPS 坐标寻找数百万个隐藏的容器，其中许多藏在公园、森林等自然地点。
works.idea_en: A simple hidden-object game can give people a reason to explore nearby nature closely.
works.idea_zh: 一个简单的寻物游戏，就能给人一个仔细探索附近自然的理由。
works.method: Began the day after selective availability was turned off in May 2000; runs on a web and app platform with user-hidden caches and logs.
works.method_zh: 始于 2000 年 5 月美国关闭 GPS 选择可用性后的第二天；在网页与应用平台上运行，由用户藏匿宝盒并记录日志。

works.title: Pokémon Go
works.description: A location-based AR game that sent hundreds of millions of people outdoors to catch virtual creatures; conservation scientists debated what it meant for interest in real wildlife.
works.description_zh: 一款基于位置的 AR 游戏，让数亿人走出户外捕捉虚拟生物；保护科学家随之讨论它对真实野生动物兴趣的影响。
works.idea_en: A game about collecting animals can get people outside, but it does not automatically make them notice real animals.
works.idea_zh: 收集动物的游戏能让人走出门，却不会自动让人注意到真实的动物。
works.method: Smartphone AR over a real-world map of points of interest; the cited paper weighs benefits and costs for conservation.
works.method_zh: 在真实世界地图兴趣点上叠加的手机 AR；所引论文评估了它对自然保护的利弊。

paper.title: Pokémon Go: Benefits, Costs, and Lessons for the Conservation Movement

works.title: PeakFinder
works.description: An app that overlays the names and heights of mountains on the view in front of you, working offline from a global elevation model.
works.description_zh: 一款应用，在眼前的景色上叠加山峰的名字和高度，基于全球高程模型离线运行。
works.idea_en: AR that names the landscape can turn a view into a place you know.
works.idea_zh: 为风景命名的 AR，能把一片景色变成你熟悉的地方。
works.method: Renders a panorama from the device's GPS position and a digital elevation model and aligns it with the camera and compass.
works.method_zh: 根据设备 GPS 位置与数字高程模型渲染全景，并与相机和指南针对齐。

works.title: Central Park (Listen to the Light)
works.description: A location-aware album for iPhone: as listeners walk through New York's Central Park, the music changes with where they are, zone by zone.
works.description_zh: 一张 iPhone 位置感知专辑：听众在纽约中央公园中行走时，音乐会随所在区域而变化。
works.idea_en: Composing for a landscape makes the walk itself the performance.
works.idea_zh: 为一片景观作曲，就让行走本身成为演出。
works.method: GPS-triggered layers of music mapped onto hundreds of zones across the park.
works.method_zh: 由 GPS 触发的音乐层，映射到公园中的数百个区域上。

works.title: Forest Walk
works.description: Cardiff's first audio walk: visitors follow her recorded voice and footsteps along a path in the Banff forest, with real and recorded sounds blending.
works.description_zh: Cardiff 的第一件音频漫步作品：观众跟随她录下的声音和脚步沿班夫森林中的小径行走，真实与录制的声音交织在一起。
