works.idea_en: Layer a recorded walk over a real forest to sharpen attention to it.
works.idea_zh: 把一段录制的行走叠加在真实森林上，让人对它更敏锐。
works.method: Binaural recording played on a portable player while walking the same route.
works.method_zh: 沿同一路线行走时，用便携播放器播放双耳录音。

works.title: FOREST (for a thousand years…)
works.description: A 28-minute sound installation for dOCUMENTA (13): visitors sit in a clearing in Kassel's Karlsaue Park while hidden speakers play wind, footsteps, battle and song among the real trees.
works.description_zh: 为第 13 届卡塞尔文献展创作的 28 分钟声音装置：观众坐在卡尔斯奥公园的林间空地上，隐藏的扬声器在真实树木间播放风声、脚步、战争与歌声。
works.idea_en: Sound placed among real trees can make a forest feel like a witness to history.
works.idea_zh: 放置在真实树木间的声音，能让森林成为历史的见证者。
works.method: Multichannel audio composition distributed across speakers mounted in trees.
works.method_zh: 多声道音频作品，分布在安装于树上的扬声器中。

works.title: Digital Naturalism
works.description: A research practice of 'hiking hacks' in which designers and biologists build electronics in the field to interact with animals such as ants, spiders and frogs.
works.description_zh: 一种“徒步黑客”研究实践：设计师和生物学家在野外现场制作电子设备，与蚂蚁、蜘蛛、青蛙等动物互动。
works.idea_en: Build tools in the field, with the animals, instead of in the lab.
works.idea_zh: 在野外、和动物一起制作工具，而不是在实验室里。
works.method: Wearable and portable microcontroller kits, performative field workshops and video documentation in Panama and elsewhere.
works.method_zh: 可穿戴与便携微控制器套件、表演式野外工作坊，以及在巴拿马等地的视频记录。

paper.title: Wild Birthplaces of Behavioral Media

works.title: Dinacon (Digital Naturalism Conference)
works.description: A self-organised, month-long 'conference' held in jungles and islands (Thailand 2018, Panama 2019, Sri Lanka 2022) where artists, hackers and biologists build projects in nature.
works.description_zh: 一个自组织、为期一个月的“会议”，在丛林和海岛上举行（2018 泰国、2019 巴拿马、2022 斯里兰卡），艺术家、黑客和生物学家在自然中做项目。
works.idea_en: Change where the conference happens and the research changes too.
works.idea_zh: 改变会议发生的地点，研究也会随之改变。
works.method: Open-call residency format with no fees for accepted projects and shared field documentation.
works.method_zh: 开放征集的驻地形式，入选项目免收费用，并共享野外记录。

works.title: iNaturalist
works.description: A social network and app where people post photos of any organism, get identifications from computer vision and other users, and create research-grade biodiversity records.
works.description_zh: 一个社交网络和应用：人们上传任何生物的照片，由计算机视觉和其他用户协助鉴定，形成科研级的生物多样性记录。
works.idea_en: Make every nature photo a shared observation that others can help name.
works.idea_zh: 让每一张自然照片都成为他人可以帮忙命名的共享观察。
works.method: Community identification plus a computer vision model trained on the community's own labelled photos; data flows to GBIF.
works.method_zh: 社区鉴定加上用社区自身标注照片训练的计算机视觉模型，数据汇入 GBIF。

works.title: Seek by iNaturalist
works.description: A family-friendly app that identifies plants and animals live through the camera without an account, and awards badges for species found.
works.description_zh: 一款适合家庭的应用：无需账号，通过相机实时识别动植物，并为找到的物种颁发徽章。
works.idea_en: Lower the entry barrier to species ID to almost zero, especially for children.
works.idea_zh: 把物种识别的门槛降到几乎为零，尤其是对儿童。
works.method: On-device image recognition model derived from iNaturalist data, with location-based species suggestions and challenges.
works.method_zh: 基于 iNaturalist 数据的本地图像识别模型，配合基于位置的物种推荐与挑战。

works.title: eBird
works.description: A global online checklist system where birders log what they see and hear; its hundreds of millions of records feed maps of bird distribution and abundance.
works.description_zh: 一个全球在线观鸟清单系统：观鸟者记录所见所闻，数亿条记录汇成鸟类分布与数量的地图。
works.idea_en: Turn a hobby's personal lists into science by asking for complete checklists and effort data.
works.idea_zh: 通过要求完整清单与观察投入数据，把一项爱好的个人记录变成科学。
works.method: Web and mobile checklists with effort metadata, automated filters and expert reviewers; data modelled into eBird Status and Trends.
works.method_zh: 带有观察投入元数据的网页与手机清单，配合自动过滤与专家审核；数据被建模为 eBird Status and Trends。

paper.title: eBird: A citizen-based bird observation network in the biological sciences

works.title: Great Backyard Bird Count
works.description: An annual four-day event each February in which anyone counts birds for at least 15 minutes and submits the list online; it was the first online citizen science project to report results in near real time.
works.description_zh: 每年二月为期四天的活动：任何人观鸟至少 15 分钟并在线提交清单；它是第一个近乎实时公布结果的在线公民科学项目。
works.idea_en: A short, bounded event makes participation easy and creates a global snapshot.
works.idea_zh: 一个时间短、有边界的活动让参与更容易，并形成一张全球快照。
works.method: Web submission (now via eBird and Merlin) aggregated into live maps during the event.
works.method_zh: 通过网页提交（现通过 eBird 与 Merlin），活动期间汇总成实时地图。

works.title: Christmas Bird Count
works.description: Started by ornithologist Frank Chapman as an alternative to the Christmas 'side hunt', volunteers count every bird within a 15-mile circle on one winter day; it has run every year since 1900.
works.description_zh: 由鸟类学家 Frank Chapman 发起，用来替代圣诞节的“猎鸟比赛”：志愿者在冬季某一天统计直径 15 英里圆圈内的所有鸟，自 1900 年起年年举行。
works.idea_en: Replace a hunting ritual with a counting ritual.
works.idea_zh: 用计数的仪式取代狩猎的仪式。
works.method: Fixed count circles with teams and compilers; results form one of the longest wildlife datasets.
works.method_zh: 固定的计数圆圈，由小组和汇编人执行；结果构成最长的野生动物数据集之一。

works.title: Snapshot Serengeti
works.description: A Zooniverse project in which volunteers classified millions of camera-trap photos from 225 cameras in Serengeti National Park, identifying species, counts and behaviour.
works.description_zh: 一个 Zooniverse 项目：志愿者为坦桑尼亚塞伦盖蒂国家公园 225 台相机拍摄的数百万张陷阱照片分类，识别物种、数量和行为。
works.idea_en: Anyone can become a field researcher by looking through a wildlife camera.
works.idea_zh: 透过一台野生动物相机，任何人都可以成为野外研究者。
works.method: Camera-trap grid run by the University of Minnesota Lion Project; multiple volunteer votes per image aggregated into consensus labels.
works.method_zh: 由明尼苏达大学狮子项目运行的相机陷阱网格；每张图像由多名志愿者投票，汇总为共识标签。

paper.title: Snapshot Serengeti, high-frequency annotated camera trap images of 40 mammalian species in an African savanna

works.title: Penguin Watch
works.description: A Zooniverse project where volunteers mark adults, chicks and eggs in time-lapse images from cameras at penguin colonies across Antarctica and the Southern Ocean.
works.description_zh: 一个 Zooniverse 项目：志愿者在南极及南大洋企鹅繁殖地的延时相机图像中标注成鸟、雏鸟和蛋。
works.idea_en: Clicking on penguins at home can monitor a whole ocean ecosystem.
works.idea_zh: 在家点击企鹅，就能监测整个海洋生态系统。
works.method: Remote time-lapse cameras run by Oxford's Penguinwatch team; volunteer clicks are clustered and used to train counting models.
works.method_zh: 由牛津大学 Penguinwatch 团队运行的远程延时相机；志愿者点击被聚类并用于训练计数模型。

paper.title: Time-lapse imagery and volunteer classifications from the Zooniverse Penguin Watch project

works.title: Globe at Night
works.description: An international campaign in which people compare the stars they can see with star charts and report the result, building a map of light pollution.
works.description_zh: 一项国际活动：人们把自己能看到的星星与星图对照并上报，由此绘制光污染地图。
works.idea_en: The night sky is nature too, and counting stars measures its loss.
works.idea_zh: 夜空也是自然，数星星就是在测量它的消失。
works.method: Web app with magnitude charts for chosen constellations; data compared with satellite measurements of sky brightness.
works.method_zh: 网页应用提供选定星座的星等图；数据与卫星测得的天空亮度相比较。

works.title: Budburst
works.description: A programme where volunteers observe the same plants through the year and record when they leaf out, flower and fruit, tracking climate effects on plant timing.
works.description_zh: 一个项目：志愿者全年观察同一批植物，记录发叶、开花和结果的时间，追踪气候对植物物候的影响。
works.idea_en: Returning to the same plant again and again builds both data and attachment.
works.idea_zh: 一次次回到同一株植物身边，既积累数据，也积累情感。
works.method: Web and app protocols for phenophases, run by the Chicago Botanic Garden (originally with NEON and UCAR).
works.method_zh: 网页与应用提供物候期观测规程，由芝加哥植物园运营（最初与 NEON 和 UCAR 合作）。

works.title: Pl@ntNet
works.description: A free app that identifies plants from photos of leaves, flowers, fruit or bark and adds each confirmed observation to a shared botanical dataset.
works.description_zh: 一款免费应用，通过叶、花、果或树皮照片识别植物，并把每条确认的观察加入共享的植物学数据集。
works.idea_en: Identification and data collection can be the same act.
works.idea_zh: 识别与数据采集可以是同一个动作。
works.method: Deep learning models trained on collaborative image collections, with regional floras and expert validation.
works.method_zh: 基于协作图像集训练的深度学习模型，配有区域植物志与专家验证。

works.title: Leafsnap
works.description: An electronic field guide app that identified tree species of the northeastern US from a photo of a single leaf on a white background.
works.description_zh: 一款电子野外图鉴应用，只需在白色背景上拍一片叶子，就能识别美国东北部的树种。
works.idea_en: A phone camera can replace the botanical key for everyday identification.
works.idea_zh: 手机相机可以在日常识别中替代植物检索表。
works.method: Leaf segmentation and curvature-based shape features matched against a database of species images, by Columbia, the University of Maryland and the Smithsonian.
works.method_zh: 由哥伦比亚大学、马里兰大学和史密森尼学会开发：叶片分割与基于曲率的形状特征，与物种图像库进行匹配。

paper.title: Leafsnap: A Computer Vision System for Automatic Plant Species Identification

works.title: Mosquito Alert
works.description: A smartphone app in which people photograph mosquitoes and breeding sites; experts validate the reports to track invasive tiger and yellow fever mosquitoes.
works.description_zh: 一款手机应用：人们拍摄蚊子和孳生地，专家审核后用于追踪入侵的白纹伊蚊和埃及伊蚊。
works.idea_en: Citizen science also covers the species we fight, not just the ones we love.
works.idea_zh: 公民科学也涵盖我们要对抗的物种，而不只是我们喜爱的物种。
works.method: Photo reports validated by entomologists and AI; data used by public health agencies across Europe.
works.method_zh: 照片报告由昆虫学家与 AI 审核，数据供欧洲各地公共卫生机构使用。

paper.title: Citizen science provides a reliable and scalable tool to track disease-carrying mosquitoes

works.title: City Nature Challenge
works.description: An annual four-day bioblitz, started as a contest between San Francisco and Los Angeles, in which cities around the world compete to record the most urban wildlife on iNaturalist.
works.description_zh: 一年一度、为期四天的生物闪电调查，最初是旧金山与洛杉矶之间的比赛，现在全球各城市比拼谁在 iNaturalist 上记录的城市野生生物最多。
works.idea_en: Friendly rivalry between cities gets residents looking at the nature on their own streets.
works.idea_zh: 城市之间的友好竞争，让居民去注意自己街头的自然。
works.method: Coordinated observation weekend followed by an identification week on iNaturalist.
works.method_zh: 先是协调一致的观察周末，随后是在 iNaturalist 上的鉴定周。
keywords: Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County

works.title: BioBlitz
works.description: A 24-hour race in which scientists and the public try to record every species in one area; the first was held at Kenilworth Aquatic Gardens in Washington, DC in 1996.
works.description_zh: 一场 24 小时的竞赛：科学家与公众一起尝试记录某一区域内的所有物种；第一次于 1996 年在华盛顿特区的 Kenilworth Aquatic Gardens 举行。
works.idea_en: Time pressure and a shared goal turn a species survey into a festival.
works.idea_zh: 时间压力和共同目标，把物种调查变成了一场节日。
works.method: Event format co-created by Sam Droege and Susan Rudy of the National Biological Service; later run with National Geographic and the US National Park Service.
works.method_zh: 由美国国家生物服务处的 Sam Droege 与 Susan Rudy 共同设计的活动形式，后来与国家地理和美国国家公园管理局合作举办。

works.title: Floracaching (Biotracker)
works.description: A geocaching-inspired, gamified mobile app (also known as Biotracker) in which players find and record plants to gather phenology data; it was tested with Millennials who were new to citizen science.
works.description_zh: 一款受地理寻宝启发的游戏化手机应用（又名 Biotracker）：玩家寻找并记录植物以收集物候数据，并在初次接触公民科学的千禧一代中进行了测试。
works.idea_en: Borrow a popular outdoor game's mechanics to recruit new kinds of volunteers.
works.idea_zh: 借用流行户外游戏的机制，招募新类型的志愿者。
works.method: Gamified phenology app with points and social features, evaluated for motivation and learning outcomes at the University of Maryland.
works.method_zh: 带积分与社交功能的游戏化物候应用，在马里兰大学评估其动机与学习效果。

paper.title: Using gamification to inspire new citizen science volunteers

works.title: Virtual Birding
works.description: A CHI paper by Mark Cottman-Fields, Margot Brereton and Paul Roe that lets birders identify birds in long environmental audio recordings online, extending birding beyond the field.
works.description_zh: Mark Cottman-Fields、Margot Brereton 与 Paul Roe 的 CHI 论文：让观鸟者在线从长时间的环境录音中识别鸟类，把观鸟延伸到野外之外。
works.idea_en: Let expert listeners annotate soundscapes remotely.
works.idea_zh: 让擅长听鸟的人远程标注声景。
works.method: Web tool for browsing spectrograms and tagging calls in recordings from acoustic sensors, studied with birders.
works.method_zh: 用于浏览声谱图、在声学传感器录音中标注鸟鸣的网页工具，并与观鸟者一起研究。

paper.title: Virtual birding: extending an environmental pastime into the virtual world for citizen science

works.title: Listening to Save Wildlife
works.description: A DIS paper by Jessica Oliver and colleagues based on three years of fieldwork with the recovery team of an endangered Australian bird, the Eastern bristlebird, trialling acoustic monitoring in their conservation work.
works.description_zh: Jessica Oliver 等人的 DIS 论文，基于与澳大利亚濒危鸟类东部刚毛鹟（Eastern bristlebird）保育团队三年的田野工作，在其保护工作中试用声学监测。
works.idea_en: Conservation technology needs design attention to the team's culture, time and knowledge, not only to sensors.
works.idea_zh: 保护技术需要关注团队的文化、时间与知识，而不只是传感器。
works.method: Ethnographic fieldwork and design research, including trials of acoustic recorders, analysed thematically.
works.method_zh: 民族志田野工作与设计研究，包括声学录音设备的试用，并进行主题分析。

paper.title: Listening to Save Wildlife: Lessons Learnt from Use of Acoustic Technology by a Species Recovery Team

works.title: Engaging with Nature Sounds & Citizen Science
works.description: A CHI paper that designs and playtests the Bristle Whistle Challenge, a prototype that connects wildlife calls to other senses and experiences to draw people into ecoacoustic citizen science.
works.description_zh: 一篇 CHI 论文，设计并试玩 Bristle Whistle Challenge 原型：把野生动物叫声与其他感官和体验相连，吸引人们参与生态声学公民科学。
works.idea_en: Audio alone is not enough; connect sounds to other senses and stories to give them meaning.
works.idea_zh: 只有声音还不够，要把声音与其他感官和故事相连，才能赋予它意义。
works.method: Game-like prototype built from environmental recordings, playtested with ten players.
works.method_zh: 基于环境录音的游戏化原型，由十名玩家试玩。

paper.title: Engaging with Nature Sounds & Citizen Science by Designing for Creative & Contextual Audio Encounters

works.title: Wildlife Insights
works.description: A cloud platform where camera-trap projects upload photos and AI models filter blanks and suggest species, with data shared for conservation analysis.
works.description_zh: 一个云平台：相机陷阱项目上传照片，AI 模型筛掉空拍并推荐物种，数据共享用于保护分析。
works.idea_en: Remove the bottleneck of manual photo sorting so wildlife data can guide action faster.
works.idea_zh: 去掉人工分拣照片的瓶颈，让野生动物数据更快地指导行动。
works.method: Google Cloud-hosted classifier trained on millions of labelled camera-trap images from partner organisations.
works.method_zh: 托管在 Google Cloud 上的分类器，用合作机构数百万张标注的相机陷阱图像训练。

works.title: Ocean Vision AI / FathomNet
works.description: An open, annotated image database of ocean life (FathomNet) and a programme to build AI tools for ocean imagery; the CHI paper maps community needs for these tools.
works.description_zh: 一个开放的海洋生物标注图像数据库（FathomNet），以及为海洋影像开发 AI 工具的项目；这篇 CHI 论文梳理了社区对这些工具的需求。
works.idea_en: The ocean is too big to watch alone; share both the images and the labelling.
works.idea_zh: 海洋太大，无法独自观察；把图像与标注一起共享。
works.method: 36 in-depth interviews and a workshop with 246 participants from 35 countries around FathomNet, yielding requirements and 12 user archetypes.
works.method_zh: 36 次深度访谈，以及一场围绕 FathomNet、来自 35 个国家的 246 人参与的工作坊，提炼出需求与 12 种用户原型。

paper.title: Designing Ocean Vision AI: An Investigation of Community Needs for Imaging-based Ocean Conservation

works.title: GROW Observatory
works.description: A European project in which thousands of growers placed low-cost soil sensors in their gardens and farms and ran planting experiments, providing ground truth for satellite soil-moisture data.
works.description_zh: 一个欧洲项目：数千名种植者在自家菜园和农场放置低成本土壤传感器并开展种植实验，为卫星土壤湿度数据提供地面实测。
works.idea_en: Growers' gardens can be a distributed climate observatory.
works.idea_zh: 种植者的菜园可以是一个分布式的气候观测站。
works.method: Parrot Flower Power sensors, online courses (MOOCs) and a data platform linked to the ESA Sentinel-1 mission.
works.method_zh: Parrot Flower Power 传感器、在线课程（MOOC）以及连接欧洲航天局 Sentinel-1 任务的数据平台。

works.title: FarmBot
works.description: An open-source gantry robot that sits over a raised bed and plants seeds, waters, weeds and photographs plants following a garden plan drawn in a web app.
works.description_zh: 一个开源龙门式机器人，架在菜畦上方，根据网页应用中绘制的菜园规划来播种、浇水、除草和拍摄植物。
works.idea_en: Make a garden programmable, then ask what care means when a robot does it.
works.idea_zh: 让菜园可编程，再追问：由机器人来照料时，照料意味着什么。
works.method: CNC-style x-y-z gantry with interchangeable tool heads, Raspberry Pi and Arduino control, and open plans and software.
works.method_zh: 类数控 x-y-z 龙门结构，可更换工具头，由 Raspberry Pi 与 Arduino 控制，设计与软件均开源。

works.title: Click & Grow Smart Garden
works.description: A countertop garden with pre-seeded soil pods, a water tank and grow lights that runs on a fixed light schedule so herbs and vegetables grow with little skill.
works.description_zh: 一个台面花园：预置种子的土壤胶囊、水箱和补光灯按固定光照程序运行，几乎不需技巧就能种出香草和蔬菜。
works.idea_en: Pack the gardener's knowledge into the pod and the lamp.
works.idea_zh: 把园丁的知识装进胶囊和灯里。
works.method: Wicking 'smart soil' inspired by NASA plant research, timed LED lighting and replaceable seed pods.
works.method_zh: 受 NASA 植物研究启发的吸水“智能土壤”、定时 LED 照明和可更换的种子胶囊。

works.title: Parrot Flower Power
works.description: A leaf-shaped Bluetooth sensor pushed into a pot or bed that measures soil moisture, fertiliser, light and temperature and tells the owner what the plant needs.
works.description_zh: 一个叶子形状的蓝牙传感器，插入花盆或苗床，测量土壤湿度、肥力、光照和温度，并告诉主人植物需要什么。
works.idea_en: Translate soil and light into simple alerts so beginners stop killing plants.
works.idea_zh: 把土壤与光照转化为简单的提醒，让新手不再养死植物。
works.method: Battery-powered sensor with a phone app linked to a plant database of several thousand species.
works.method_zh: 电池供电的传感器，配有连接数千种植物数据库的手机应用。

works.title: Lua Smart Planter
works.description: A planter with a small screen that shows a cartoon face: the plant looks thirsty, cold, or happy depending on soil moisture, temperature and light.
works.description_zh: 一个带小屏幕的花盆，屏幕显示卡通表情：根据土壤湿度、温度和光照，植物会显得口渴、发冷或开心。
works.idea_en: Give a plant emotions so its needs are read at a glance, though at the risk of turning it into a pet.
works.idea_zh: 赋予植物情绪，让人一眼读懂它的需求，但也可能把它变成一只宠物。
works.method: Sensors in the pot drive animated facial expressions on a small matrix display, with a companion app.
works.method_zh: 花盆中的传感器驱动小型点阵屏上的动画表情，并配有配套应用。

works.title: Distributed Robotic Garden
works.description: A tomato garden at MIT CSAIL tended by small mobile robots that water, locate and harvest fruit, with each plant networked to request care.
works.description_zh: MIT CSAIL 的一个番茄花园，由小型移动机器人浇水、定位和采摘果实，每株植物都联网，可以“请求”照料。
works.idea_en: Let plants call for care and let a swarm of robots answer.
works.idea_zh: 让植物呼叫照料，让一群机器人来回应。
works.method: iRobot Create bases with arms and cameras, plant pots with soil sensors and a wireless mesh network.
works.method_zh: 带机械臂和摄像头的 iRobot Create 底盘、带土壤传感器的花盆以及无线网状网络。

works.title: Personal Food Computer (MIT OpenAg)
works.description: A sealed growth chamber that controls light, humidity, temperature and CO2 to run shareable 'climate recipes' for crops; the project closed in 2020 after criticism that results were overstated.
works.description_zh: 一个密封的种植舱，控制光照、湿度、温度和二氧化碳，运行可分享的作物“气候配方”；该项目在被批评夸大成果后于 2020 年关闭。
works.idea_en: A climate can be treated as code, but claims about it need evidence.
works.idea_zh: 气候可以被当作代码，但关于它的说法需要证据。
works.method: Open hardware chamber with sensors, actuators and a data platform from the MIT Media Lab.
works.method_zh: MIT 媒体实验室的开源硬件种植舱，配有传感器、执行器和数据平台。

works.title: HCI in the Garden
works.description: An OzCHI mapping review by Shannon Rodgers, Bernd Ploderer and Margot Brereton of 28 HCI papers on gardening, identifying themes and gaps.
works.description_zh: Shannon Rodgers、Bernd Ploderer 与 Margot Brereton 的 OzCHI 综述，梳理 28 篇关于园艺的 HCI 论文，归纳主题与空白。
works.idea_en: Garden HCI can go beyond care tasks: sharing discoveries, serving older adults, playing and relaxing.
works.idea_zh: 园艺 HCI 可以超越照料任务：分享发现、服务老年人、游戏与放松。
works.method: Mapping review finding six themes: discovery, connecting, bringing the garden inside, coordinating, sustainability and learning skills.
works.method_zh: 综述归纳出六个主题：发现、联结、把花园带进室内、协调、可持续与技能学习。

paper.title: HCI in the Garden: Current Trends and Future Directions

works.title: Networked Gardens
works.description: A DIS study by Kellie Vella and colleagues in which eight participants used the Ambient Birdhouse and garden sensors to notice, share and explore data about the nature around their homes.
works.description_zh: Kellie Vella 等人的 DIS 研究：八名参与者使用 Ambient Birdhouse 和花园传感器，去留意、分享并探索家附近的自然数据。
works.idea_en: Local nature data becomes meaningful when it is shown back in the garden it came from.
works.idea_zh: 本地自然数据只有被展示回它所来自的花园时，才变得有意义。
works.method: IoT birdhouse and sensors, interviews and group discussions; analysis of how media 'remediation' opened different entry points to nature data.
works.method_zh: 物联网鸟屋与传感器，配合访谈和小组讨论；分析媒介“再媒介化”如何为自然数据打开不同的入口。

paper.title: Networked Gardens: Remediating Local Nature Data Through the Internet of Things

works.title: Sociality and Skill Sharing in the Garden
works.description: A CHI paper, with Amanda Lazar, on how experienced gardeners share embodied skills and help others attune to sensory cues, and what social technology could add.
works.description_zh: 与 Amanda Lazar 合作的 CHI 论文，研究资深园丁如何分享具身技能、帮助他人调谐感官线索，以及社会性技术可以补充什么。
works.idea_en: Gardeners shape their gardens for sociality; the garden itself teaches others who see it.
works.idea_zh: 园丁按社交偏好布置花园，花园本身也在教导看到它的人。
works.method: Participant observation with nine experienced gardeners aged 22–71.
works.method_zh: 对九位 22 至 71 岁资深园丁的参与式观察。

paper.title: Sociality and Skill Sharing in the Garden

works.title: Extended Reality to Connect Experts and Novices in the Garden
works.description: A CSCW study that probes how mixed-reality video calls and annotations could let expert gardeners guide novices in their own gardens.
works.description_zh: 一项 CSCW 研究，探讨混合现实视频通话与标注如何让资深园丁远程指导新手打理自家花园。
works.idea_en: Remote expertise works best when it is anchored to the actual plant in front of the novice.
works.idea_zh: 远程专业知识在锚定于新手眼前那株真实植物时效果最好。
works.method: Two studies with 27 expert and novice gardeners using XR prototypes.
works.method_zh: 两项研究，27 位资深与新手园丁使用 XR 原型。

paper.title: Probing the Potential of Extended Reality to Connect Experts and Novices in the Garden

works.title: "Mate, we don't need a chip to tell us the soil's dry"
works.description: A DIS paper based on ethnographic fieldwork and a participatory design workshop with urban agriculture communities, whose members largely resisted technology in their growing practices.
works.description_zh: 一篇 DIS 论文，基于对城市农业社群的民族志田野工作与参与式设计工作坊；社群成员大多抗拒在种植实践中引入技术。
works.idea_en: Urban growers value hands-on knowledge; design should support their community goals rather than automate the soil check.
works.idea_zh: 城市种植者看重亲手获得的知识；设计应支持他们的社群目标，而不是把查看土壤这件事自动化。
works.method: Fieldwork with community gardeners and a design workshop, analysed for values and opportunities for sustainable HCI.
works.method_zh: 与社区园丁开展田野工作和设计工作坊，分析其中的价值观以及可持续 HCI 的机会。

paper.title: "Mate, we don't need a chip to tell us the soil's dry": opportunities for designing interactive systems to support urban food production

works.title: Nature Fictions
works.description: A DIS paper by Shannon Rodgers, Kellie Vella, Bernd Ploderer and Margot Brereton in which 15 gardeners used a phenology wheel, nature cards and paper prototypes to imagine sustainable futures that include nonhuman stakeholders.
works.description_zh: Shannon Rodgers、Kellie Vella、Bernd Ploderer 与 Margot Brereton 的 DIS 论文：15 位园丁借助物候轮、自然卡片和纸原型，想象把非人类利益相关者纳入其中的可持续未来。
works.idea_en: Start future-making from the relations in your own garden.
works.idea_zh: 从你自家花园中的种种关系出发去构想未来。
works.method: Co-design workshops situated in gardens; outcomes grouped into three design spaces: community building, multispecies care, and balance in public spaces.
works.method_zh: 在花园中进行的共同设计工作坊；成果归为三个设计空间：社群建设、多物种照料，以及公共空间中的平衡。

paper.title: Nature Fictions: Designing for a Sustainable Future through Nature Relations

works.title: Of Smarthomes, IoT Plants, and Implicit Interaction Design
works.description: A TEI paper by Björn Bittner, Ilhan Aslan and colleagues that augments houseplants' non-verbal signals so they remind people to water them, instead of automating the watering away.
works.description_zh: Björn Bittner、Ilhan Aslan 等人的 TEI 论文：增强室内植物的非语言信号，提醒人去浇水，而不是把浇水自动化掉。
works.idea_en: Keep caring routines that are good for people; augment them instead of automating them.
works.idea_zh: 保留对人有益的照料习惯，去增强它们，而不是把它们自动化。
works.method: Field study with 24 participants comparing an augmented-reality design with embedded physical computing on the plants.
works.method_zh: 24 名参与者的实地研究，比较增强现实方案与嵌入植物的物理计算方案。

paper.title: Of Smarthomes, IoT Plants, and Implicit Interaction Design

works.title: The Talking Plants
works.description: An interactive system at Spitalfields City Farm in London: visitors touch plants with an RFID watering can and hear them talk about their care, uses and histories in the voices of farm staff and volunteers.
works.description_zh: 伦敦 Spitalfields 城市农场的一个交互系统：访客用带 RFID 的浇水壶靠近植物，就能听到植物用农场员工和志愿者的声音讲述照料方法、用途与历史。
works.idea_en: Plants can become storytellers for a community's local knowledge.
works.idea_zh: 植物可以成为社区在地知识的讲述者。
works.method: RFID-augmented watering can triggering recorded plant voices, developed with a grassroots food-growing community.
works.method_zh: 带 RFID 的浇水壶触发录制的植物声音，与草根种植社区共同开发。

paper.title: The talking plants: an interactive system for grassroots urban food-growing communities

works.title: Plantix
works.description: A crop-health app that diagnoses plant diseases, pests and nutrient problems from a photo and suggests treatments, used mainly by smallholder farmers in India.
works.description_zh: 一款作物健康应用，通过照片诊断植物病害、虫害与营养问题并给出处理建议，主要被印度的小农户使用。
works.idea_en: A phone camera can bring plant pathology to farmers who never see an agronomist.
works.idea_zh: 手机相机能把植物病理学带给从未见过农艺师的农民。
works.method: Deep learning on a large crowd-sourced image library of crop symptoms, with community Q&A.
works.method_zh: 基于大规模众包作物症状图像库的深度学习，并配有社区问答。

works.title: A Foray into the Worlds of Animals and Humans
works.description: A short illustrated book describing how a tick, a bee or a dog each lives in its own sensory world, or Umwelt, made only of the signals it can perceive and act on.
works.description_zh: 一本配有插图的小书，描述蜱虫、蜜蜂或狗如何各自生活在自己的感官世界（环世界）中，这个世界只由它能感知并作出反应的信号构成。
works.idea_en: Every creature lives in a different world; design can let us visit some of them.
works.idea_zh: 每种生物都生活在不同的世界中，设计可以让我们去拜访其中一些。
works.method: Thought experiments and drawings (with Georg Kriszat) contrasting a scene as perceived by different species.
works.method_zh: 用思想实验和插图（与 Georg Kriszat 合作）对比同一场景在不同物种眼中的样子。
keywords: Streifzüge durch die Umwelten von Tieren und Menschen

works.title: An Immense World
works.description: A book that tours the senses of animals, from ultraviolet vision and echolocation to electric and magnetic senses, to show how much of the world humans miss.
works.description_zh: 一本书，巡游动物的各种感官，从紫外视觉、回声定位到电感与磁感，揭示人类错过了世界的多少部分。
works.idea_en: Designing for other species starts with admitting how narrow human perception is.
works.idea_zh: 为其他物种设计，要从承认人类感知有多狭窄开始。
works.method: Science journalism built on interviews and lab visits with sensory biologists.
works.method_zh: 基于对感官生物学家的采访和实验室探访写成的科学报道。

works.title: What Is It Like to Be a Bat?
works.description: A philosophy essay arguing that even if we knew everything about bat echolocation, we could not know what it is like for the bat.
works.description_zh: 一篇哲学论文，认为即便我们知道关于蝙蝠回声定位的一切，也无法知道成为蝙蝠是什么感觉。
works.idea_en: Sensory simulation can approach another animal's world but never enter its experience.
works.idea_zh: 感官模拟可以接近另一种动物的世界，却无法进入它的体验。
works.method: Philosophical argument about subjective experience and the limits of physical explanation.
works.method_zh: 关于主观体验与物理解释之局限的哲学论证。

paper.title: What Is It Like to Be a Bat?

works.title: Eyeborg (Cyborg Antenna)
works.description: An antenna osseointegrated in Harbisson's skull that converts light frequencies, including infrared and ultraviolet, into sound vibrations he hears through bone.
works.description_zh: 一根与 Harbisson 颅骨骨融合的天线，把光的频率（包括红外和紫外）转换为他通过骨传导听到的声音振动。
works.idea_en: A new sense can become part of a person's body and identity.
works.idea_zh: 一种新的感官可以成为一个人身体与身份的一部分。
works.method: Camera sensor on an antenna feeding a chip that maps hue to pitch, with bone conduction and Bluetooth for remote colour input.
works.method_zh: 天线上的摄像头传感器连接芯片，把色相映射为音高，并通过骨传导和蓝牙接收远程颜色输入。

works.title: Seismic Sense
works.description: Sensors implanted in Ribas's feet, linked to online seismographs, vibrate whenever an earthquake happens anywhere on Earth; she translates them into dance.
works.description_zh: 植入 Ribas 双脚、连接在线地震仪的传感器，只要地球上任何地方发生地震就会振动，她把这些振动转化为舞蹈。
works.idea_en: Feel the planet's movement continuously through your body.
works.idea_zh: 用身体持续感受地球的运动。
works.method: Vibration implants driven by real-time seismic data; performed in the piece 'Waiting for Earthquakes'.
works.method_zh: 由实时地震数据驱动的振动植入物；在作品《等待地震》中演出。

works.title: North Sense
works.description: A small device attached to the chest by piercings that vibrates whenever the wearer faces magnetic north, offering a consumer version of a migratory bird's magnetic sense.
works.description_zh: 一个通过穿孔固定在胸前的小装置，佩戴者面朝磁北时就会振动，是候鸟磁感的消费版本。
works.idea_en: Sell a new sense as something to live with, not a tool to use.
works.idea_zh: 把一种新感官作为可以与之共同生活的东西出售，而不是一件工具。
works.method: Compass sensor and vibration motor in a silicone housing attached with titanium bars.
works.method_zh: 硅胶外壳中的指南针传感器与振动马达，用钛金属棒固定。

works.title: feelSpace Belt
works.description: A belt of vibration motors in which the motor facing north always buzzes; after weeks of wearing it, participants reported a changed sense of space.
works.description_zh: 一条装有振动马达的腰带，朝北的那个马达始终振动；佩戴数周后，参与者报告自己的空间感发生了变化。
works.idea_en: Humans can learn a sense that other animals have, if it is worn long enough.
works.idea_zh: 只要佩戴得够久，人也能学会其他动物拥有的感官。
works.method: Electronic compass driving 13 vibrotactile elements; six-week training study with sleep and navigation tests.
works.method_zh: 电子罗盘驱动 13 个振动触觉单元；为期六周的训练研究，含睡眠与导航测试。

paper.title: Beyond sensory substitution—learning the sixth sense

works.title: treelab
works.description: An ongoing project that records the acoustic emissions inside trees, such as cavitation when water columns break during drought, and turns them with physiological data into sound works.
works.description_zh: 一个持续进行的项目：录制树木内部的声发射（如干旱时水柱断裂产生的空穴声），并与生理数据一起转化为声音作品。
works.idea_en: A tree under drought stress can be heard, if you listen with the right sensors.
works.idea_zh: 只要用对传感器，就能听见一棵在干旱中挣扎的树。
works.method: Contact and ultrasonic sensors on trunks combined with sap-flow and climate data, with the Swiss Federal Institute WSL (Roman Zweifel).
works.method_zh: 在树干上安装接触式与超声传感器，结合树液流与气候数据，与瑞士联邦森林、雪与景观研究所 WSL（Roman Zweifel）合作。

works.title: A Tree's Perspective
works.description: A CHI paper testing a multisensory VR experience that transitions people from their own body into a tree's perspective, and its effect on nature connectedness.
works.description_zh: 一篇 CHI 论文，测试一个多感官 VR 体验：让人从自己的身体过渡到一棵树的视角，并考察它对自然联结的影响。
works.idea_en: The transition into another body may matter as much as the body you arrive in.
works.idea_zh: 进入另一个身体的过渡过程，可能与最终抵达的身体同样重要。
works.method: Mixed-methods VR study (N = 20) varying transitional elements and multisensory stimuli; both raised presence, embodiment and nature connectedness, with emotional effects lasting a week.
works.method_zh: 混合方法 VR 研究（N = 20），改变过渡元素与多感官刺激；两者都提升了临场感、具身感与自然联结，情感联结的提升在一周后仍在。

paper.title: A Tree's Perspective: Enhancing Nature Connectedness Through Transitional and Multisensory Virtual Reality Experiences

works.title: Vatnajökull (the sound of)
works.description: An underwater microphone in Jökulsárlón lagoon was connected to a phone line so that anyone could call a number and hear Iceland's Vatnajökull glacier melting live.
works.description_zh: 在冰岛 Jökulsárlón 冰湖中放置水下麦克风并接入电话线，任何人拨打一个号码，就能实时听到瓦特纳冰川融化的声音。
works.idea_en: A phone call can put a melting glacier in your ear.
works.idea_zh: 一通电话，就能把融化的冰川放进你的耳朵。
works.method: Hydrophone, amplifier and mobile phone relay installed at the glacier lagoon; the number was shown in neon in the gallery.
works.method_zh: 在冰川湖安装水听器、放大器和手机中继；电话号码以霓虹灯形式展示在展厅中。

works.title: GoatMan: A Holiday from Being Human
works.description: The designer built prosthetic legs and an artificial rumen and spent days crossing the Swiss Alps with a herd of goats, trying to experience life as a goat.
works.description_zh: 设计师制作了假肢和人工瘤胃，并与一群山羊一起在瑞士阿尔卑斯山中行走数日，试图体验作为山羊的生活。
works.idea_en: Trying and failing to become another animal teaches both humility and humour.
works.idea_zh: 尝试变成另一种动物并失败，能同时教会人谦逊与幽默。
works.method: Custom prosthetics made with a prosthetist, consultations with neuroscientists and animal behaviourists, and fieldwork in the Alps.
works.method_zh: 与假肢师一起定制假肢，咨询神经科学家与动物行为学家，并在阿尔卑斯山做田野。

works.title: UbiGreen
works.description: A mobile app that senses how people travel and shows green trips on the phone's wallpaper as a growing tree or a polar bear whose ice floe expands.
works.description_zh: 一款手机应用，感知用户的出行方式，把绿色出行显示在手机壁纸上：一棵长大的树，或一只冰面逐渐扩大的北极熊。
works.idea_en: Put ambient nature imagery on the lock screen to reflect everyday environmental choices.
works.idea_zh: 在锁屏上放置环境式的自然图像，映射日常的环保选择。
works.method: Semi-automatic activity sensing with a wearable sensor and phone, plus ambient wallpaper; three-week field study with 13 participants.
works.method_zh: 借助可穿戴传感器与手机半自动感知出行，配合环境式壁纸；对 13 名参与者进行了三周的实地研究。

paper.title: UbiGreen: investigating a mobile tool for tracking and supporting green transportation habits

works.title: inAir
works.description: A home device, by Sunyoung Kim and Eric Paulos, that measures indoor fine particulates, shows the level on a display and lets households share readings through a social network.
works.description_zh: Sunyoung Kim 与 Eric Paulos 设计的家用设备，测量室内细颗粒物，在屏幕上显示读数，并让家庭通过社交网络分享数据。
works.idea_en: Making invisible indoor air visible changes everyday habits like cooking and cleaning.
works.idea_zh: 让看不见的室内空气变得可见，会改变做饭、打扫这样的日常习惯。
works.method: Particle counter with a visual display and social sharing, deployed in homes for four weeks.
works.method_zh: 带可视显示与社交分享功能的颗粒物计数器，在家庭中部署四周。

paper.title: InAir: sharing indoor air quality measurements and visualizations

works.title: Common Sense: Street Sweeper Air Sensing
works.description: A project that mounted air quality sensors on San Francisco street sweepers and worked with community activists in West Oakland to map pollution.
works.description_zh: 一个项目：把空气质量传感器装到旧金山的街道清扫车上，并与西奥克兰的社区行动者合作绘制污染地图。
works.idea_en: Put sensors on vehicles that already cover every street, and give the data to communities who need it.
works.idea_zh: 把传感器装在本就走遍每条街的车辆上，再把数据交给需要它的社区。
works.method: Vehicle-mounted CO, NOx and O3 sensors with GPS, plus fieldwork with environmental justice groups (Intel Research Berkeley).
works.method_zh: 车载一氧化碳、氮氧化物、臭氧传感器与 GPS，结合与环境正义团体的田野工作（英特尔伯克利研究院）。

paper.title: A vehicle for research: using street sweepers to explore the landscape of environmental community action

works.title: Smell Pittsburgh
works.description: An app in which residents report bad odours with a rating and description; reports are mapped with air-monitor data and sent to the county health department.
works.description_zh: 一款应用：居民为难闻气味打分并描述，报告与空气监测数据一起标注在地图上，并发送给县卫生部门。
works.idea_en: The human nose is a pollution sensor, and collective reports become evidence.
works.idea_zh: 人的鼻子就是污染传感器，集体的报告会成为证据。
works.method: Mobile reporting app, map visualisation and machine learning that predicts smell events from sensor data.
works.method_zh: 手机报告应用、地图可视化，以及根据传感器数据预测异味事件的机器学习。

paper.title: Smell Pittsburgh: Community-Empowered Mobile Smell Reporting System

works.title: Community-Empowered Air Quality Monitoring System
works.description: A system that combines time-lapse video of an industrial facility's smoke, community air sensors and smell reports so residents can build evidence of pollution events.
works.description_zh: 一个系统，结合工业设施排烟的延时视频、社区空气传感器与异味报告，让居民为污染事件建立证据。
works.idea_en: Let communities see, sense and document their air themselves.
works.idea_zh: 让社区自己去看见、感知并记录他们的空气。
works.method: Web platform linking a high-resolution camera, low-cost sensors and crowdsourced reports, developed with Pittsburgh residents.
works.method_zh: 连接高清摄像头、低成本传感器与众包报告的网页平台，与匹兹堡居民共同开发。

paper.title: Community-Empowered Air Quality Monitoring System

works.title: ActuAir
works.description: A large shape- and colour-changing display in a smart office building that responds to air-quality data, evaluated with the people who work there.
works.description_zh: 一块安装在智能办公楼中的大型变形变色显示装置，随空气质量数据变化，并与在那里工作的人一起评估。
works.idea_en: Air quality becomes noticeable when it changes the shape of the room.
works.idea_zh: 当空气质量改变房间的形状时，它就会被注意到。
works.method: Three prototype-led studies with 21 occupants over June–August 2022, analysed thematically.
works.method_zh: 2022 年 6 至 8 月与 21 名使用者进行的三项原型研究，并作主题分析。

paper.title: Evaluating ActuAir: Building Occupants' Experiences of a Shape-Changing Air Quality Display

works.title: Pollution Pods
works.description: Five linked geodesic domes that recreate the air of Tautra (Norway), London, New Delhi, Beijing and São Paulo, so visitors walk from clean to polluted air.
works.description_zh: 五个相连的测地线穹顶，重现挪威 Tautra、伦敦、新德里、北京和圣保罗的空气，让观众从洁净空气走进污染空气。
works.idea_en: Let the body feel air-quality statistics.
works.idea_zh: 让身体去感受空气质量统计数据。
works.method: Safe mixtures of humidity, temperature and scent recreate each city's pollutant profile inside the domes.
works.method_zh: 在穹顶内以安全的湿度、温度和气味组合重现每座城市的污染特征。

works.title: Smog Free Tower
works.description: A seven-metre tower that cleans surrounding air with positive ionisation; the captured carbon particles are compressed into 'Smog Free Rings'.
works.description_zh: 一座七米高的塔，用正离子化技术净化周边空气；收集到的碳颗粒被压制成“无霾戒指”。
works.idea_en: Make clean air a place you can stand in and smog a thing you can hold.
works.idea_zh: 让洁净空气成为你可以站进去的地方，让雾霾成为你可以握在手里的东西。
works.method: Ionisation-based air purifier using about 1,170 watts, shown in Rotterdam, Beijing, Tianjin, Kraków and elsewhere.
works.method_zh: 基于离子化的空气净化装置，功率约 1170 瓦，在鹿特丹、北京、天津、克拉科夫等地展出。

works.title: Warming Stripes
works.description: A graphic of coloured vertical stripes, one per year, from blue (cool) to red (warm), showing temperature change since 1850 without axes or numbers.
works.description_zh: 一幅由彩色竖条组成的图形，每年一条，从蓝（冷）到红（暖），不用坐标轴或数字就展示出 1850 年以来的温度变化。
works.idea_en: Strip a chart down to colour and it can become a shared symbol.
works.idea_zh: 把图表精简到只剩颜色，它就能成为共同的符号。
works.method: Annual temperature anomalies mapped to a fixed colour scale; open site generates stripes for any country.
works.method_zh: 把年度温度距平映射到固定色阶；开放网站可为任何国家生成条纹图。

works.title: Climate Clock
works.description: A countdown clock on the Metronome in New York's Union Square showing how long until the world's carbon budget for 1.5 °C is used up, alongside a 'lifeline' of renewable energy share.
works.description_zh: 纽约联合广场 Metronome 上的倒计时钟，显示距离全球 1.5 °C 碳预算耗尽还剩多少时间，旁边是可再生能源占比的“生命线”。
works.idea_en: Turn an abstract carbon budget into a deadline on a clock.
works.idea_zh: 把抽象的碳预算变成钟面上的截止时间。
works.method: Real-time calculation from Mercator Research Institute (MCC) carbon budget data on a large LED display.
works.method_zh: 基于墨卡托研究所（MCC）碳预算数据实时计算，显示在大型 LED 屏上。

works.title: A Song of Our Warming Planet
works.description: A cello piece in which each note is a year of global temperature from 1880 on, rising in pitch as the planet warms.
works.description_zh: 一首大提琴曲：每个音符代表 1880 年以来的一年全球温度，随地球变暖而音高上升。
works.idea_en: Hearing warming as rising pitch makes a trend felt in a few minutes.
works.idea_zh: 把变暖听作不断升高的音高，几分钟内就能感受到一种趋势。
works.method: NASA GISS temperature records mapped to pitch across the cello's range.
works.method_zh: 把 NASA GISS 温度记录映射到大提琴的音域上。

works.title: Particle Falls
works.description: A large projection on a building facade that shows a blue waterfall, with bursts of orange and white particles as a nearby sensor detects fine particulate pollution in real time.
works.description_zh: 投射在建筑立面上的大型影像：一面蓝色瀑布，当附近的传感器实时探测到细颗粒物污染时，橙白色的粒子会迸发出来。
works.idea_en: Show invisible pollution as a beautiful, legible public image.
works.idea_zh: 把看不见的污染呈现为美丽、易读的公共影像。
works.method: Nephelometer measuring PM2.5 drives generative projection software; shown in San Jose, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh and other cities.
works.method_zh: 测量 PM2.5 的浊度计驱动生成式投影软件；在圣何塞、费城、匹兹堡等城市展出。

works.title: Nuage Vert
works.description: A green laser traced the outline of the steam cloud from the Salmisaari power plant in Helsinki; the cloud grew as local residents cut their electricity use.
works.description_zh: 绿色激光勾勒出赫尔辛基 Salmisaari 电厂排出的蒸汽云轮廓；当地居民用电减少时，光圈会变大。
works.idea_en: Draw on the emissions themselves to make consumption visible in the sky.
works.idea_zh: 直接在排放物上作画，让能耗在天空中可见。
works.method: Tracking laser projection with real-time consumption data from the utility, part of the Pixelache festival.
works.method_zh: 跟踪式激光投影结合电力公司的实时用电数据，为 Pixelache 艺术节作品。

works.title: Pigeon Air Patrol
works.description: Racing pigeons in London wore tiny backpacks measuring NO2 and ozone, and people could tweet the birds to get live air-quality readings.
works.description_zh: 伦敦的赛鸽背着测量二氧化氮和臭氧的微型背包，人们可以给鸽子发推文，获取实时空气质量读数。
works.idea_en: An urban animal can become a messenger for the air everyone breathes.
works.idea_zh: 城市中的动物可以成为空气信使，传递大家都在呼吸的空气状况。
works.method: Lightweight sensor and GPS backpacks with a Twitter bot, made with DigitasLBi and Twitter UK.
works.method_zh: 轻量传感器与 GPS 背包，配合推特机器人，与 DigitasLBi 和 Twitter UK 合作完成。

works.title: Asunder
works.description: A 'responsible environmental manager' that uses a supercomputer to generate proposals for altering real places, from rerouting rivers to removing cities, to stay within planetary limits.
works.description_zh: 一个“负责任的环境管理者”：用超级计算机为改造真实地点生成方案，从改道河流到拆除城市，以求守住地球的承载界限。
works.idea_en: Let an AI optimise the planet and watch the absurdity of treating nature as a system to solve.
works.idea_zh: 让 AI 去优化地球，看清把自然当作待解问题的系统有多荒诞。
works.method: Climate and geographic data, a state-of-the-art climate model and generative adversarial imagery running on a supercomputer, with Julian Oliver and Bengt Sjölén.
works.method_zh: 气候与地理数据、先进的气候模型与生成对抗图像在超级计算机上运行，与 Julian Oliver 和 Bengt Sjölén 合作。

works.title: Solar Protocol
works.description: A website hosted on a network of small solar-powered servers around the world; the page is served from whichever server has the most sunlight at that moment.
works.description_zh: 一个托管在全球小型太阳能服务器网络上的网站；页面总是由此刻阳光最充足的那台服务器提供。
works.idea_en: Let the sun, not the user, decide how the web behaves.
works.idea_zh: 让太阳而不是用户来决定网络如何运行。
works.method: Raspberry Pi servers with solar panels and batteries, routing by solar logic; with Benedetta Piantella and Alex Nathanson.
works.method_zh: 配有太阳能板和电池的 Raspberry Pi 服务器按“太阳逻辑”路由；与 Benedetta Piantella、Alex Nathanson 合作。

works.title: Harvest
works.description: A wind turbine whose electricity powers computers that mine cryptocurrency; the profits are donated to climate change research.
works.description_zh: 一台风力发电机，所发电力驱动挖掘加密货币的计算机，收益捐给气候变化研究。
works.idea_en: Tie computation directly to weather and to the problem it contributes to.
works.idea_zh: 把计算直接与天气、以及计算所加剧的问题绑在一起。
works.method: Small wind turbine, battery bank and mining hardware in a field installation, first shown in Sweden.
works.method_zh: 野外装置中的小型风机、电池组与挖矿硬件，首次在瑞典展出。

works.title: Weather Scores
works.description: Woven basket-like sculptures that encode storm data such as wind, pressure and temperature, which also serve as musical scores performed by musicians.
works.description_zh: 类似编织篮筐的雕塑，编码了风速、气压、温度等风暴数据，同时也是由音乐家演奏的乐谱。
works.idea_en: Weather data can become both an object and a piece of music.
works.idea_zh: 天气数据既能成为一件物品，也能成为一首音乐。
works.method: Hand-woven reed and wood structures mapped from meteorological records, translated into scores with collaborating musicians.
works.method_zh: 根据气象记录手工编织的芦苇与木结构，并与音乐家合作转译为乐谱。

works.title: Ecosia
works.description: A search engine that spends its advertising profit on tree-planting projects and shows each user a running count of the trees their searches have helped fund.
works.description_zh: 一个搜索引擎，把广告利润用于植树项目，并向每位用户显示其搜索帮助资助的树木累计数。
works.idea_en: Attach a visible ecological counter to a mundane digital habit.
works.idea_zh: 给一种平凡的数字习惯配上可见的生态计数器。
works.method: Ad-funded search with a per-user tree counter, monthly financial reports and planting partners in many countries.
works.method_zh: 广告支持的搜索，带个人植树计数器、月度财务报告，以及分布在多个国家的植树合作伙伴。

works.title: Global Forest Watch
works.description: An open online platform that shows tree cover loss and deforestation alerts worldwide from satellite data, updated weekly.
works.description_zh: 一个开放的在线平台，基于卫星数据展示全球树木覆盖的减少与毁林预警，每周更新。
works.idea_en: Make forest loss visible to anyone, almost as it happens.
works.idea_zh: 让任何人几乎实时地看到森林的消失。
works.method: Landsat-based tree cover change maps (University of Maryland) and GLAD alerts on a web map with subscriptions.
works.method_zh: 基于 Landsat 的树木覆盖变化图（马里兰大学）与 GLAD 预警，呈现在可订阅的网页地图上。

works.title: Treepedia
works.description: A website that measures the 'Green View Index' of city streets from Google Street View images and compares canopy cover across cities.
works.description_zh: 一个网站，利用谷歌街景图像测量城市街道的“绿视率”，并比较各城市的树冠覆盖。
works.idea_en: Measure urban nature from the pedestrian's eye level, not from above.
works.idea_zh: 从行人的视线高度而不是从空中去衡量城市自然。
works.method: Computer vision segmentation of street-level imagery into vegetation pixels, mapped per street segment.
works.method_zh: 对街景图像进行计算机视觉分割，统计植被像素，并按路段制图。

works.title: Safecast
works.description: A volunteer project that built open-source Geiger counters after the Fukushima disaster and published over 150 million radiation readings as open data, later adding air quality.
works.description_zh: 福岛核事故后，志愿者项目开发了开源盖革计数器，并把超过 1.5 亿条辐射读数作为开放数据公开，之后又扩展到空气质量。
works.idea_en: When official data fail, citizens can build their own trusted measurements.
works.idea_zh: 当官方数据缺位时，公民可以建立自己可信的测量。
works.method: bGeigie Nano kits mounted on cars and bikes logging GPS-tagged readings to an open map.
works.method_zh: 装在汽车和自行车上的 bGeigie Nano 套件记录带 GPS 的读数，上传到开放地图。

works.title: Grassroots Balloon Mapping
works.description: A method using cameras lifted by helium balloons and kites to make aerial maps; volunteers used it to document the Deepwater Horizon oil spill on the Gulf Coast.
works.description_zh: 一种用氦气球和风筝吊起相机制作航拍地图的方法；志愿者用它记录了墨西哥湾沿岸的深水地平线漏油事件。
works.idea_en: A cheap balloon can give communities their own view from above.
works.idea_zh: 一只便宜的气球就能让社区拥有自己的俯瞰视角。
works.method: Point-and-shoot camera in a soda-bottle rig, tethered balloon, and MapKnitter software to stitch images.
works.method_zh: 装在汽水瓶支架中的傻瓜相机、系留气球，以及用于拼接图像的 MapKnitter 软件。

works.title: Smart Citizen Kit
works.description: An open-source sensor kit that residents install at home to measure air quality, noise, light and temperature and share on a public map.
works.description_zh: 一套开源传感器套件，居民装在家中测量空气质量、噪声、光照和温度，并分享到公共地图上。
works.idea_en: Environmental data about a neighbourhood can be produced by the people who live there.
works.idea_zh: 关于一个街区的环境数据，可以由住在那里的人来生产。
works.method: Arduino-compatible board with gas, particle and sound sensors, Wi-Fi upload and an open data platform.
works.method_zh: 兼容 Arduino 的主板，搭载气体、颗粒物和声音传感器，通过 Wi-Fi 上传到开放数据平台。

works.title: Sensor.Community (Luftdaten)
works.description: A volunteer network of home-built particulate matter sensors, started in Stuttgart, that now has tens of thousands of sensors in over 70 countries on a live map.
works.description_zh: 一个由自制颗粒物传感器组成的志愿者网络，始于斯图加特，如今在 70 多个国家拥有数万个传感器，显示在实时地图上。
works.idea_en: A cheap, well-documented kit can scale into a continental sensing network.
works.idea_zh: 一套便宜、文档完善的套件，可以扩展成覆盖整个大陆的感知网络。
works.method: NodeMCU microcontroller with an SDS011 particle sensor in drainpipe housing, uploading to open data servers.
works.method_zh: NodeMCU 微控制器配 SDS011 颗粒物传感器，装在排水管外壳中，上传到开放数据服务器。

works.title: BirdCast
works.description: Nightly forecasts and live maps of bird migration across the US, made from weather radar, which power 'Lights Out' alerts asking cities to dim lights on heavy migration nights.
works.description_zh: 基于气象雷达、覆盖全美的每夜鸟类迁徙预报与实时地图，并用于“熄灯”提醒，请城市在迁徙高峰夜调暗灯光。
works.idea_en: Forecast birds like weather so people can act when it matters.
works.idea_zh: 像预报天气一样预报鸟类，让人们在关键时刻采取行动。
works.method: Machine learning models on NEXRAD radar and weather data, with Colorado State University and UMass Amherst.
works.method_zh: 基于 NEXRAD 雷达和气象数据的机器学习模型，与科罗拉多州立大学和马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校合作。

paper.title: A continental system for forecasting bird migration

works.title: Tangible Earth
works.description: A one-to-ten-million-scale interactive digital globe that people spin by hand to see real-time clouds, earthquakes, ocean temperatures and other planetary data.
works.description_zh: 一个千万分之一比例的交互式数字地球仪，人们用手转动它，查看实时云图、地震、海温等地球数据。
works.idea_en: Holding the planet in your hands makes its systems feel close.
works.idea_zh: 把星球捧在手中，会让它的系统显得亲近。
works.method: Spherical rear-projection screen with a touch-sensitive rotation interface and live data feeds.
works.method_zh: 带触感旋转交互的球形背投屏，接入实时数据源。

works.title: Wind Map
works.description: A live web map of the winds across the US drawn as flowing white strokes, updated hourly from the National Digital Forecast Database; later acquired by MoMA.
works.description_zh: 一张美国风场的实时网页地图，以流动的白色线条绘制，每小时根据国家数字预报数据库更新；后被纽约现代艺术博物馆收藏。
works.idea_en: Invisible weather becomes a living landscape when drawn as motion.
works.idea_zh: 看不见的天气被画成运动时，就成了一片活的风景。
works.method: Particle advection over hourly surface wind forecasts, rendered in the browser.
works.method_zh: 在浏览器中基于每小时地表风预报进行粒子平流渲染。

works.title: earth.nullschool.net
works.description: An animated globe showing global winds, ocean currents, waves, temperature and pollution as flowing particles, updated every few hours from forecast models.
works.description_zh: 一个动态地球仪，以流动的粒子显示全球风、洋流、海浪、温度与污染，每隔数小时根据预报模型更新。
works.idea_en: Let people spin the planet and watch its air and water move.
works.idea_zh: 让人转动星球，看它的空气和水在流动。
works.method: Browser visualisation of GFS, OSCAR and GEOS-5 data with D3 and canvas particle rendering.
works.method_zh: 在浏览器中用 D3 与 canvas 粒子渲染可视化 GFS、OSCAR 与 GEOS-5 数据。

works.title: A Plasma Display Window? The Shifting Baseline Problem
works.description: An experiment in which office workers had a real window, a plasma screen showing a live HDTV nature view, or a blank wall; heart rate recovered faster with the real window than with the screen.
works.description_zh: 一项实验：办公室分别配有真实窗户、实时播放高清自然景观的等离子屏，或一面空墙；面对真实窗户时心率恢复得比面对屏幕更快。
works.idea_en: A screen of nature is not a window onto nature, even if it looks the same.
works.idea_zh: 自然的屏幕不是通往自然的窗，即使看起来一样。
works.method: Controlled lab study with 90 participants measuring heart rate recovery after mild stress; companion field study in inside offices.
works.method_zh: 90 名参与者的对照实验，测量轻度压力后的心率恢复；另有在无窗内部办公室中的田野研究。

paper.title: A plasma display window?—The shifting baseline problem in a technologically mediated natural world

works.title: Hardware Companions? AIBO Discussion Forums
works.description: A CHI paper, with Batya Friedman and Jennifer Hagman, analysing 6,438 posts from online AIBO forums to see whether owners treat the robot dog as an artefact or as a living companion.
works.description_zh: 与 Batya Friedman、Jennifer Hagman 合写的 CHI 论文，分析在线 AIBO 论坛的 6438 条帖子，看主人把机器狗当作物件还是活的伴侣。
works.idea_en: People attribute social life to robot animals while knowing they are machines, which changes what 'pet' means.
works.idea_zh: 人们明知机器动物是机器，却仍赋予它社会生命，这改变了“宠物”的含义。
works.method: Content analysis of forum postings coded for technological essences, life-like essences, mental states, social rapport and moral standing.
works.method_zh: 对论坛帖子进行内容分析，编码技术本质、生命特征、心理状态、社会关系与道德地位。

paper.title: Hardware companions?: what online AIBO discussion forums reveal about the human-robotic relationship

works.title: Artificial Window View of Nature
works.description: A CHI paper by Adnan Radikovic, John Leggett, John Keyser and Roger Ulrich describing a large display that renders a nature view which responds to the viewer's head position like a real window.
works.description_zh: Adnan Radikovic、John Leggett、John Keyser 与 Roger Ulrich 的 CHI 论文，介绍一块大屏幕，渲染的自然景观会像真窗一样随观者头部位置变化。
works.idea_en: If a screen must replace a window, give it the parallax and depth of a real one.
works.idea_zh: 如果屏幕必须取代窗户，就让它拥有真实窗户的视差和纵深。
works.method: Head-tracked rendering of a 3D nature scene on a wall display for windowless rooms.
works.method_zh: 在无窗房间的墙面显示器上，根据头部追踪渲染三维自然场景。

paper.title: Artificial window view of nature

works.title: Atmoph Window
works.description: A wall-mounted screen framed like a window that plays thousands of long-take landscape videos with sound, including live views, to bring distant nature into rooms.
works.description_zh: 一块外框像窗户的壁挂屏幕，播放数千段带声音的长镜头风景视频（包括实时画面），把远方的自然带进房间。
works.idea_en: The plasma window became a consumer product: consider what it gives and what it takes.
works.idea_zh: “等离子窗”已成为消费品：想想它给予了什么，又拿走了什么。
works.method: Wi-Fi display with a library of 4K landscape footage and ambient sound, controlled from a phone app.
works.method_zh: 联网显示器配备 4K 风景片库与环境声，通过手机应用控制。

works.title: CoeLux Artificial Skylight
works.description: An artificial skylight that reproduces the blue sky and a sharp, warm sun with realistic depth, for windowless rooms and basements.
works.description_zh: 一种人造天窗，以逼真的纵深再现蓝天和一轮清晰温暖的太阳，用于无窗房间和地下室。
works.idea_en: Simulate the physics of the sky, not just its picture.
works.idea_zh: 模拟天空的物理，而不只是它的图像。
works.method: LED source and nanostructured material that reproduces Rayleigh scattering, from Paolo Di Trapani's research at the University of Insubria.
works.method_zh: LED 光源与可再现瑞利散射的纳米结构材料，源于因苏布里亚大学 Paolo Di Trapani 的研究。

works.title: A Forest Where Gods Live
works.description: A night-time exhibition in the 50-hectare Mifuneyama Rakuen garden in Kyushu, where projections and lights on ancient trees, caves, rocks and ponds respond to visitors.
works.description_zh: 在九州 50 公顷的御船山乐园举行的夜间展览，投射在古树、洞窟、岩石和池塘上的影像与灯光会回应观众。
works.idea_en: Digital art can make people look again at an old forest instead of replacing it.
works.idea_zh: 数字艺术可以让人重新凝视一座古老的森林，而不是取代它。
works.method: Interactive projection mapping and responsive lighting placed across the garden's natural features.
works.method_zh: 在庭园自然景物中布置交互投影映射与响应式灯光。

works.title: Flowers and People, Cannot be Controlled but Live Together
works.description: A room of digital flowers that grow, bloom and scatter in real time through the seasons; flowers grow faster where people stand still and wither when touched.
works.description_zh: 一个满是数字花朵的房间：花随季节实时生长、开放和凋落；人静止不动的地方花开得更快，被触碰时则凋零。
works.idea_en: A digital ecosystem can respond to human presence the way a real one does.
works.idea_zh: 数字生态系统可以像真实生态一样回应人的存在。
works.method: Real-time computer rendering (not pre-recorded) with visitor tracking across projected walls.
works.method_zh: 实时计算机渲染（非预录），在投影墙面上追踪观众。

works.title: Moss Garden of Resonating Microcosms
works.description: An outdoor moss garden at teamLab Planets in Tokyo filled with egg-shaped 'ovoids' that change colour and emit sound when pushed by people or wind, rippling across the garden.
works.description_zh: 东京 teamLab Planets 户外苔藓庭园中布满蛋形的“卵形体”，被人或风推动时会变色并发出声音，在庭园中层层传递。
works.idea_en: Let wind, visitors and moss share one interactive surface.
works.idea_zh: 让风、观众与苔藓共享同一个交互界面。
works.method: Self-righting light objects with sensors, LEDs and speakers placed over living moss.
works.method_zh: 带传感器、LED 与扬声器的不倒翁式发光体，放置在活苔藓之上。

works.title: Graffiti Nature
works.description: Children colour paper animals and flowers that are scanned and come alive in a projected ecosystem, where creatures eat, multiply and die depending on what else lives there.
works.description_zh: 孩子们给纸上的动物和花朵涂色，扫描后它们在投影出的生态系统中复活，根据周围的生物进食、繁殖或死亡。
works.idea_en: Let children draw species into an ecosystem and watch the food web act on them.
works.idea_zh: 让孩子把物种“画”进生态系统，看食物网如何作用于它们。
works.method: Drawing scanner, real-time simulation of predator–prey rules and floor and wall projection.
works.method_zh: 绘画扫描仪、捕食-被捕食规则的实时模拟，以及地面与墙面投影。

works.title: Machine Hallucinations: Nature Dreams
works.description: A series of large LED 'data paintings' in which a generative model trained on hundreds of millions of nature photographs morphs through landscapes and flowers.
works.description_zh: 一个大型 LED“数据绘画”系列：用数亿张自然照片训练的生成模型，在风景与花朵之间不断变形。
works.idea_en: An AI trained on nature images shows us our collective, mediated image of nature.
works.idea_zh: 用自然图像训练的 AI，向我们展示了我们集体的、被媒介化的自然图像。
works.method: StyleGAN-type models trained on publicly available nature photos, rendered as fluid pigment-like animations.
works.method_zh: 以公开自然照片训练的 StyleGAN 类模型，渲染成流动的颜料般动画。

works.title: Large Nature Model
works.description: An open-source generative AI model trained only on images and sounds of nature, gathered with institutions such as the Smithsonian and the Natural History Museum London, and shown as immersive installations.
works.description_zh: 一个只用自然图像与声音训练的开源生成式 AI 模型，数据与史密森尼学会、伦敦自然历史博物馆等机构合作采集，并以沉浸式装置展出。
works.idea_en: A foundation model of nature raises the question of who owns the digital image of the living world.
works.idea_zh: 一个自然的基础模型，引出“谁拥有生命世界的数字图像”这个问题。
works.method: Diffusion-style model trained on a curated archive of nature data, including the studio's own rainforest recordings.
works.method_zh: 扩散类模型，训练数据为精选的自然数据档案，包括工作室自己的雨林录音。

works.title: Rain Room
works.description: A field of falling water that stops wherever visitors walk, so people can stand inside a downpour without getting wet.
works.description_zh: 一片落水之场，观众走到哪里雨就在哪里停下，让人可以站在大雨中却不被淋湿。
works.idea_en: Technology can make a weather phenomenon respond to you, and that changes how rain feels.
works.idea_zh: 技术可以让一种天气现象回应你，而这会改变雨的感受。
works.method: 3D cameras track bodies and switch off solenoid valves in a ceiling grid above each person.
works.method_zh: 3D 摄像头追踪人体，并关闭每人头顶天花板网格中的电磁阀。

works.title: The Weather Project
works.description: An artificial sun made of hundreds of mono-frequency lamps, a mirrored ceiling and fine mist filled Tate Modern's Turbine Hall; visitors lay on the floor to watch themselves under it.
works.description_zh: 由数百盏单频灯、镜面天花板和细雾组成的人造太阳，充满了泰特现代美术馆的涡轮大厅；观众躺在地上观看阳光下的自己。
works.idea_en: An obviously artificial sun made people talk about weather and togetherness.
works.idea_zh: 一个明显人造的太阳，却让人谈论起天气与共处。
works.method: Semicircle of yellow sodium lamps doubled by a mirrored ceiling, humidifiers producing mist, and exposed construction.
works.method_zh: 半圆形的黄色钠灯经镜面天花板映成满圆，加湿器制造雾气，结构刻意暴露。

works.title: Walden, a game
works.description: A first-person game that simulates Henry David Thoreau's two years at Walden Pond; players must survive but are rewarded for noticing nature and reading, and neglecting beauty drains their inspiration.
works.description_zh: 一款第一人称游戏，模拟梭罗在瓦尔登湖的两年；玩家要维持生存，但注意自然和阅读会得到奖励，忽视美则会让“灵感”枯竭。
works.idea_en: A game can reward attention and slowness instead of conquest.
works.idea_zh: 游戏可以奖励专注与缓慢，而不是征服。
works.method: Open-world simulation of the seasons built from Thoreau's text, developed over ten years at the USC Game Innovation Lab.
works.method_zh: 依据梭罗文本构建的四季开放世界模拟，在南加州大学游戏创新实验室开发十年。

works.title: Proteus
works.description: A game about walking around a procedurally generated island through the seasons, where every plant, creature and weather event makes music.
works.description_zh: 一款在程序生成的岛屿上随四季漫步的游戏，每一株植物、每一只生物和每一种天气都会发出音乐。
works.idea_en: Exploration and listening can be the whole point of a nature game.
works.idea_zh: 探索和聆听本身就可以是一款自然游戏的全部意义。
works.method: Procedural terrain and flora generation with a generative soundtrack by David Kanaga tied to objects in view.
works.method_zh: 程序生成地形与植被，配合 David Kanaga 的生成式配乐，声音与视野中的物体绑定。

works.title: Flower
works.description: A game in which the player is the wind, carrying a stream of petals across fields to make flowers bloom and bring colour back to a grey city.
works.description_zh: 一款游戏：玩家化身为风，带着一串花瓣掠过原野，让花朵绽放，并为灰色的城市带回色彩。
works.idea_en: Play as a natural force rather than a character.
works.idea_zh: 扮演一种自然力量，而不是一个角色。
works.method: Motion-controlled flight using the PlayStation Sixaxis controller over dense simulated grass fields.
works.method_zh: 借助 PlayStation Sixaxis 手柄体感控制，在密集的模拟草地上飞行。

works.title: Eco
works.description: A multiplayer game in which players build a civilisation on a planet with a simulated ecosystem; overhunting, pollution or deforestation can cause extinctions and collapse.
works.description_zh: 一款多人游戏：玩家在一个带模拟生态系统的星球上建设文明；过度狩猎、污染或砍伐会导致物种灭绝与生态崩溃。
works.idea_en: A shared, fragile ecosystem makes players negotiate laws to protect it.
works.idea_zh: 一个共享而脆弱的生态系统，会促使玩家协商立法来保护它。
works.method: Agent-based ecosystem simulation with species populations, pollution and climate, plus in-game government and economy.
works.method_zh: 基于智能体的生态模拟，包括物种种群、污染与气候，并有游戏内的政府与经济系统。

works.title: Alba: A Wildlife Adventure
works.description: A game in which a girl photographs and identifies the birds and animals of a Mediterranean island and campaigns to save its nature reserve; the studio pledged to plant a real tree for each player.
works.description_zh: 一款游戏：小女孩在一座地中海岛屿上拍摄、识别鸟类和动物，并为拯救岛上的自然保护区奔走；工作室承诺为每位玩家种下一棵真树。
works.idea_en: A game about noticing wildlife can also plant trees in the world.
works.idea_zh: 一款关于留意野生动物的游戏，也可以在现实中种树。
works.method: Open-world game with a camera-based species-ID mechanic, partnered with Ecologi for tree planting.
works.method_zh: 带拍照识别物种机制的开放世界游戏，与 Ecologi 合作植树。

works.title: Terra Nil
works.description: A 'reverse city builder' in which players turn wasteland into thriving biomes and then recycle all their machines and leave no trace.
works.description_zh: 一款“反向城市建造”游戏：玩家把荒地变成繁茂的生物群落，然后回收所有机器，不留痕迹地离开。
works.idea_en: Invert a genre's goal from building up to restoring and leaving.
works.idea_zh: 把一个游戏类型的目标从“建设”翻转为“修复并离开”。
works.method: Strategy game with ecological succession rules for soil, water, climate and species.
works.method_zh: 带有土壤、水、气候与物种生态演替规则的策略游戏。

works.title: Beyond Blue
works.description: An ocean exploration game in which players scan sperm whales, sharks and reef life as a marine biologist, with unlockable mini-documentaries from BBC Blue Planet II.
works.description_zh: 一款海洋探索游戏：玩家以海洋生物学家的身份扫描抹香鲸、鲨鱼与珊瑚礁生物，并可解锁 BBC《蓝色星球 II》的迷你纪录片。
works.idea_en: Pair play with real science footage so the game points back to the actual ocean.
works.idea_zh: 把游戏与真实科学影像配对，让游戏指向真实的海洋。
works.method: Narrative game developed with ocean scientists and the BBC Natural History Unit.
works.method_zh: 与海洋科学家和 BBC 自然历史部合作开发的叙事游戏。

works.title: Nature Treks VR
works.description: A VR app of calm natural environments, from forests to underwater and space, where users can plant trees, call animals and change the weather.
works.description_zh: 一款宁静自然环境的 VR 应用，从森林到水下再到太空，用户可以种树、召唤动物、改变天气。
works.idea_en: Virtual nature as a relaxation tool, used where real nature is out of reach, such as hospitals.
works.idea_zh: 把虚拟自然当作放松工具，用于真实自然难以触及的地方，如医院。
works.method: Game-engine environments for consumer headsets with simple magical interactions and ambient audio.
works.method_zh: 面向消费级头显的游戏引擎环境，带简单的“魔法”交互与环境音。

works.title: theBlu: Whale Encounter
works.description: A short room-scale VR piece in which a life-size blue whale swims past the viewer standing on the deck of a shipwreck.
works.description_zh: 一段简短的房间尺度 VR 作品：观众站在沉船甲板上，一头真实大小的蓝鲸从身旁游过。
works.idea_en: Scale is what VR does best: meeting an animal at its true size.
works.idea_zh: 尺度是 VR 最擅长的：以真实大小与动物相遇。
works.method: Real-time rendered underwater scene for HTC Vive, part of the theBlu series.
works.method_zh: 为 HTC Vive 实时渲染的水下场景，属于 theBlu 系列。

works.title: Can Simulated Nature Support Mental Health?
works.description: An experiment comparing six minutes outdoors in nature, a 360-degree VR video recorded at the same spot, and an indoor setting: both nature conditions were restorative, but positive mood rose only outdoors.
works.description_zh: 一项实验，比较在户外自然中六分钟、观看同一地点录制的 360 度 VR 视频，以及室内环境：两种自然条件都有恢复作用，但积极情绪只在户外时上升。
works.idea_en: Virtual nature helps, but it maintains mood rather than lifting it as the real place does.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟自然有帮助，但它只能维持情绪，而不像真实场所那样提升情绪。
works.method: Experiment with undergraduate students measuring skin conductance, restorativeness and mood before and after exposure.
works.method_zh: 以本科生为被试的实验，在暴露前后测量皮肤电导、恢复感与情绪。

paper.title: Can Simulated Nature Support Mental Health? Comparing Short, Single-Doses of 360-Degree Nature Videos in Virtual Reality With the Outdoors

works.title: Supertree Grove
works.description: Eighteen vertical gardens 25–50 metres tall in Singapore's Gardens by the Bay, clad in living plants, that collect rainwater, vent the conservatories and host nightly light and sound shows.
works.description_zh: 新加坡滨海湾花园中 18 棵高 25 至 50 米的垂直花园，覆盖着活植物，收集雨水、为温室排气，并每晚举行灯光音乐秀。
works.idea_en: An engineered tree can carry real plants and real ecological functions.
works.idea_zh: 一棵工程化的树，可以承载真实的植物和真实的生态功能。
works.method: Steel frames with planting panels of over 160,000 plants, photovoltaic cells and ducts linked to the biomass-powered cooling system (Grant Associates).
works.method_zh: 钢框架配 16 万多株植物的种植面板、光伏电池，以及与生物质冷却系统相连的风道（Grant Associates 设计）。

works.title: Biosphere 2
works.description: A 1.27-hectare sealed glass structure in Arizona containing rainforest, ocean, savanna, desert and farm, in which eight people lived for two years (1991–93) as an experiment in closed ecosystems.
works.description_zh: 亚利桑那州一座 1.27 公顷的封闭玻璃建筑，内含雨林、海洋、稀树草原、沙漠和农田；1991 至 1993 年间八人在其中生活两年，进行封闭生态实验。
works.idea_en: Building a whole nature inside technology reveals how much we do not understand.
works.idea_zh: 在技术之内建造一整个自然，会揭示我们有多少不了解。
works.method: Airtight steel-and-glass spaceframe with engineered biomes and 'lungs' for air pressure; oxygen fell and CO2 rose as soil microbes respired.
works.method_zh: 气密的钢与玻璃空间网架结构，内有人工生物群落和调节气压的“肺”；土壤微生物的呼吸导致氧气下降、二氧化碳上升。

works.title: Artificial Nature
works.description: A series of immersive installations and VR worlds populated by evolving artificial organisms that feed, grow and reproduce in a simulated ecosystem that visitors disturb and nourish.
works.description_zh: 一系列沉浸式装置和 VR 世界，其中的人工生物在模拟生态中觅食、生长和繁殖，观众既会扰动它，也会滋养它。
works.idea_en: Make digital nature alive: give it its own evolution rather than a scripted loop.
works.idea_zh: 让数字自然是活的：赋予它自己的演化，而不是预设的循环。
works.method: Real-time artificial life simulation with fluid dynamics and generative graphics, built in the authors' own software (e.g. Max/Gen).
works.method_zh: 带流体动力学与生成图形的实时人工生命模拟，使用作者自研软件（如 Max/Gen）构建。

works.title: Eden
works.description: An evolving sonic ecosystem of artificial creatures that sing to find food and mates; visitors' presence, sensed by cameras, makes food grow, so the creatures evolve songs that keep people nearby.
works.description_zh: 一个会演化的声音生态系统，其中的人工生物通过歌唱寻找食物与配偶；摄像头感知到观众在场时食物会生长，于是生物演化出能留住观众的歌声。
works.idea_en: Link an artificial ecosystem's survival to human attention and watch it adapt.
works.idea_zh: 把人工生态的生存与人的注意力挂钩，看它如何适应。
works.method: Cellular world projected on translucent screens, with evolving agents whose behaviour and sound are learned; infrared sensing of visitors.
works.method_zh: 投影在半透明屏上的元胞世界，智能体的行为与声音通过学习演化；红外感知观众。

works.title: Inner Garden
works.description: An augmented sandbox in which people shape terrain by hand; their breathing and heart rate change the weather, sea and plant growth in the projected miniature world, supporting mindfulness.
works.description_zh: 一个增强沙盘：人们用手塑造地形，他们的呼吸和心率会改变投影微缩世界中的天气、海洋与植物生长，用于辅助正念。
works.idea_en: Map inner states to a living landscape you can see and touch.
works.idea_zh: 把内在状态映射到一片可见、可触的活景观上。
works.method: Kinect depth sensing and projection over sand, with physiological sensors and a VR mode.
works.method_zh: Kinect 深度感知与沙面投影，配合生理传感器和 VR 模式。

paper.title: Inner Garden: Connecting Inner States to a Mixed Reality Sandbox for Mindfulness

works.title: Awavena
works.description: A VR work made with the Yawanawá people of the Brazilian Amazon, in which the forest is shown as seen in the visions of Hushahu, the community's first female shaman.
works.description_zh: 与巴西亚马逊地区 Yawanawá 族人共同创作的 VR 作品，森林以社群第一位女萨满 Hushahu 的视觉幻象呈现。
works.idea_en: Digital nature can carry Indigenous ways of seeing the forest, made with the community.
works.idea_zh: 数字自然可以承载原住民看待森林的方式，前提是与社群共同创作。
works.method: Volumetric capture and particle-based rendering developed with the community; premiered at Sundance 2018.
works.method_zh: 与社群共同开发的体积捕捉与粒子渲染；2018 年在圣丹斯首映。

works.title: Fragile Future
works.description: Light sculptures in which real dandelion seed heads are glued seed by seed onto LEDs and connected by bronze circuits that can grow like a network.
works.description_zh: 光雕塑：把真实的蒲公英种子一粒粒粘在 LED 上，并用可以像网络一样延展的青铜电路连接起来。
works.idea_en: Combine the most fragile natural form with electronics to ask what future they share.
works.idea_zh: 把最脆弱的自然形态与电子器件结合，追问它们共享怎样的未来。
works.method: Hand-harvested dandelions preserved and attached to LEDs on modular phosphor-bronze frames.
works.method_zh: 手工采集的蒲公英经保存后粘贴在 LED 上，安装于模块化磷青铜框架。

works.title: Franchise Freedom
works.description: A night performance in which hundreds of lit drones fly as a flock, following an algorithm based on research into starling murmurations.
works.description_zh: 一场夜间表演：数百架发光无人机依据对椋鸟群飞的研究所编写的算法，像鸟群一样飞行。
works.idea_en: Rebuild a natural spectacle with machines and ask what freedom the flock has.
works.idea_zh: 用机器重建一种自然奇观，并追问鸟群拥有怎样的自由。
works.method: Swarm-control software modelled on flocking rules, run on custom drones; shown at Art Basel Miami, Burning Man and Central Park.
works.method_zh: 依据集群规则编写的群控软件，运行在定制无人机上；在迈阿密巴塞尔艺博会、火人节和中央公园演出。

works.title: Strandbeest
works.description: Large walking skeletons of PVC tubing that are powered by wind on Dutch beaches, store air in bottles, and in later generations sense water and turn back from the sea.
works.description_zh: 用 PVC 管制作的大型行走骨架，在荷兰海滩上靠风驱动，把空气储存在瓶中，后代机型还能感知海水并掉头远离大海。
works.idea_en: Treat machines as a new species that evolves generation by generation to survive a habitat.
works.idea_zh: 把机器当作一个新物种，一代代演化以在某个栖息地中生存。
works.method: Jansen's linkage legs, computer-evolved proportions, wind sails and pneumatic 'muscles' and 'nerves'.
works.method_zh: Jansen 连杆腿、计算机演化出的比例、风帆以及气动“肌肉”与“神经”。
